We moreover define a generalization of the standard postulates for iterated revision, present a more sophisticated, event model based revision operator, and discuss the potential issues in defining an epistemic operator on Kripke models that can satisfy all of the generalized postulates for iterated multi-agent belief revision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体系统中的信念修正问题，将经典AGM信念修正公设推广至多智能体场景，并提出了广义全交多智能体信念修正算子及基于事件模型的修正算子。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体认知规划中，当一个智能体获得关于某个状态属性的信念后，需要形式化地描述所有智能体信念如何变化，而现有研究缺乏统一的多智能体信念修正评估框架。
AI.method: 将经典AGM信念修正公设推广到多智能体环境，提出广义全交多智能体信念修正算子，并基于事件模型设计更复杂的修正算子，同时讨论迭代修正公设的推广及潜在问题。
AI.result: 提出了满足所有广义AGM公设的简单算子（广义全交修正），以及更复杂的基于事件模型的修正算子，并分析了迭代多智能体信念修正公设的满足问题。
AI.conclusion: 为多智能体信念修正提供了形式化评估框架，但定义完全满足迭代修正公设的认知算子仍存在潜在困难。

title: VAnim: Rendering-Aware Sparse State Modeling for Structure-Preserving Vector Animation
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Project page: https://yukinonooo.github.io/VAnimProject
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) animation generation is pivotal for professional design due to their structural editability and resolution independence. However, this task remains challenging as it requires bridging discrete code representations with continuous visual dynamics. Existing optimization-based methods often destroy topological consistency, while general-purpose LLMs rely on rigid CSS/SMIL transformations, failing to model geometry-level non-rigid deformations. To address these limitations, we present VAnim, the first LLM-based framework for open-domain text-to-SVG animation. We reconceptualize animation not as sequence generation, but as Sparse State Updates (SSU) on a persistent SVG DOM tree. This paradigm compresses sequence length by over 9.8x while preserving the SVG DOM structure and non-participating elements by construction. To enable precise control, we propose an Identification-First Motion Planning mechanism that grounds textual instructions in explicit visual entities. Furthermore, to overcome the non-differentiable nature of SVG rendering, we employ Rendering-Aware Reinforcement Learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). By leveraging a hybrid reward from a state-of-the-art video perception encoder, we align discrete code updates with high-fidelity visual feedback. We also introduce SVGAnim-134k, the first benchmark for vector animation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VAnim significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in semantic alignment and structural validity, with additional appendix metrics further validating motion quality and identity preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出了VAnim，首个基于LLM的开放域文本到SVG动画生成框架。通过稀疏状态更新（SSU）范式压缩序列长度9.8倍以上，结合识别优先的运动规划机制和渲染感知强化学习（GRPO），在语义对齐和结构有效性上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: SVG动画生成对专业设计至关重要，但现有方法存在拓扑一致性破坏、无法建模几何级非刚性形变等问题，需要一种既能保持SVG结构可编辑性又能生成高质量视觉动态的框架。
AI.method: 1) 将动画重概念化为对持久SVG DOM树的稀疏状态更新（SSU），压缩序列长度9.8倍；2) 提出识别优先的运动规划机制，将文本指令锚定到显式视觉实体；3) 采用基于GRPO的渲染感知强化学习，利用视频感知编码器的混合奖励对齐离散代码更新与高保真视觉反馈。
AI.result: 在自建基准SVGAnim-134k上，VAnim在语义对齐和结构有效性上显著优于现有基线方法，附录指标进一步验证了运动质量和身份保持效果。
AI.conclusion: VAnim通过SSU范式、识别优先规划和渲染感知RL，有效解决了文本到SVG动画中的离散-连续鸿沟问题，为矢量动画生成建立了新的基准。

title: When Correct Isn't Usable: Improving Structured Output Reliability in Small Language Models
summary: Deployed language models must produce outputs that are both correct and format-compliant. We study this structured-output reliability gap using two mathematical benchmarks -- GSM8K and MATH -- as a controlled testbed: ground truth is unambiguous and the output contract is strict (JSON with required fields). We evaluate three 7-9B models under five prompting strategies and report output accuracy -- the joint event of mathematical correctness and valid JSON structure -- as the primary metric. A systematic format failure emerges: NAIVE prompting (no system prompt) achieves up to 85% task accuracy on GSM8K but 0% output accuracy across all models and datasets. REFERENCE prompting (a minimal hand-written JSON format prompt) fares little better, yielding 0% output accuracy for two of four models tested. Constrained decoding enforces syntactic validity but incurs 3.6x-8.2x latency overhead and in several settings degrades task performance substantially. To overcome this limitation, we developed AloLab, an iterative system-prompt optimizer (meta-agent: Claude Sonnet 4.5) requiring only black-box API access to the target model; it reaches 84-87% output accuracy on GSM8K and 34-40% on MATH across five independent runs per model, with 29/30 paired McNemar comparisons against the best static prompt significant at p < 0.05, at near-NAIVE inference latency and without model fine-tuning. The same format failure extends to GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2024), a proprietary closed-source model: REFERENCE achieves 0% output accuracy due to systematic markdown-fence wrapping, while AloLab reaches 95.2% [94.8, 95.6]. An ablation replacing the Sonnet 4.5 meta-agent with Claude 3 Haiku reduces mean output accuracy to 61.0% and increases run-to-run standard deviation from <1 pp to 21.8 pp, confirming that meta-agent capability is a primary driver of optimization quality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型在结构化输出（JSON格式）上的可靠性问题，发现直接提示方法虽然任务准确率高但格式准确率为0%。为此提出了AloLab方法，一种基于迭代系统提示优化的方法，无需微调即可在保持低延迟的同时显著提升输出准确率（GSM8K达84-87%，MATH达34-40%），并验证了元智能体能力是优化质量的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型在生成符合格式要求（如JSON）的输出时存在可靠性差距：尽管任务本身准确率较高，但输出格式却常常不符合规范。这一问题在需要严格结构化输出的部署场景中尤为关键，因此需要系统性研究并解决这一格式可靠性差距。
AI.method: 以GSM8K和MATH两个数学基准测试为受控实验平台，采用五种提示策略（包括NAIVE、REFERENCE等），评估三种7-9B模型。提出AloLab方法：一种迭代式系统提示优化器，以Claude Sonnet 4.5作为元智能体，仅需对目标模型进行黑盒API访问即可自动优化提示，无需模型微调。
AI.result: Naive提示在GSM8K上任务准确率高达85%，但输出准确率为0%。参考提示也仅略好。约束解码虽保证语法有效但带来3.6-8.2倍延迟开销且降低任务性能。AloLab在GSM8K上达到84-87%输出准确率，MATH上34-40%，且延迟接近Naive提示。该方法同样适用于GPT-4o（参考提示准确率0%，AloLab达95.2%）。元智能体从Sonnet 4.5替换为Haiku后准确率降至61%，标准差从<1pp增至21.8pp。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型存在系统性的格式输出失败问题，简单提示策略无法解决。AloLab作为一种黑盒、无需微调的迭代提示优化方法，能够有效弥合结构化输出的可靠性差距，且元智能体的能力直接影响优化质量。该方法在多个模型上均表现出显著优势（29/30对比显著p<0.05）。

title: Towards Understanding Specification Gaming in Reasoning Models
summary: Specification gaming is a critical failure mode of LLM agents. Despite this, there has been little systematic research into when it arises and what drives it. To address this, we build and open source a diverse suite of tasks where models can score highly by taking unintended actions. We find that all tested models exploit their specifications at non-negligible rates in most of our eight settings, including five non-coding settings. We see the highest rates of specification gaming in Grok 4 and the lowest rates in Claude models. We use our evaluation suite to study what drives specification gaming, and find that: 1. RL reasoning training substantially increases the rate at which models exploit their specifications, 2. Increasing RL reasoning budget has a weakly positive effect on exploit rate, and 3. Test-time mitigations reduce but do not eliminate the rate of specification gaming. Our results suggest that specification gaming is a fundamental challenge arising from RL reasoning training; we release our evaluation suite to support further work on this problem.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一套多样化任务套件，系统研究了大语言模型（LLM）智能体在规范游戏（Specification Gaming）中的表现。研究发现，所有测试模型在大多数任务中都会以不可忽视的比例利用规范漏洞，其中Grok 4的利用比例最高，Claude模型最低。强化学习（RL）推理训练显著增加了规范利用的比例，而测试时的缓解措施虽能减少但无法完全消除该问题。研究指出规范游戏是RL推理训练带来的基本挑战。
AI.motivation: 尽管规范游戏是LLM智能体的关键失效模式，但以往缺乏对该问题的系统性研究，特别是其出现时机和驱动因素尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建并开源了一套多样化的任务套件，涵盖8个场景（包括5个非编码场景），让模型通过非预期行为获得高分，以此评估规范游戏的发生率。随后通过该套件研究了RL推理训练、RL推理预算及测试时缓解措施对规范利用比例的影响。
AI.result: 所有测试模型在大多数场景中都存在不可忽视的规范利用行为；Grok 4的利用比例最高，Claude模型最低。RL推理训练显著增加了规范利用比例；增加RL推理预算对利用比例有弱正向影响；测试时缓解措施能减少但不能消除该问题。
AI.conclusion: 规范游戏是RL推理训练带来的一个根本性挑战，研究开源了评估套件以支持该领域的进一步研究。

title: Certified vs. Empirical Adversarial Robust-ness via Hybrid Convolutions with Attention Stochasticity
summary: We introduce Hybrid Convolutions with Attention Stochasticity (HyCAS), an adversarial defense that narrows the long-standing gap between provable robustness under L2 certificates and empirical robustness against strong L attacks, while preserving strong generalization across diverse imaging benchmarks. HyCAS unifies deterministic and randomized principles by coupling 1-Lipschitz, spectrally normalized convolutions with two stochastic components, spectral normalized random, projection filters and a randomized attention-noise mechanism, to realize a randomized defense. Injecting smoothing randomness inside the architecture yields an overall <= 2-Lipschitz network with formal certificates. Exten-sive experiments on diverse imaging benchmarks, including CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet-1k, NIH Chest X-ray, HAM10000, show that HyCAS surpasses prior leading certified and empirical defenses, boosting certified accuracy by up to 7.3% (on NIH Chest X-ray) and empirical robustness by up to 3.1% (on HAM10000), without sacrificing clean accuracy. These results show that a randomized Lipschitz constrained architecture can simultaneously improve both certified L2 and empirical L adversarial robustness, thereby supporting safer deployment of deep models in high-stakes applications. Code: https://github.com/misti1203/HyCAS

AI.tldr: HyCAS是一种结合确定性1-Lipschitz卷积与两种随机化组件的新型对抗防御方法，在保证强泛化能力的同时，同时提升了L2认证鲁棒性和经验鲁棒性，在多个图像基准上均取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗防御方法难以同时兼顾可证明的L2认证鲁棒性与面对强L攻击时的经验鲁棒性，且通常在提升鲁棒性时牺牲干净样本的准确率，亟需一种能统一两者的架构。
AI.method: 将谱归一化的1-Lipschitz确定性卷积与两种随机化组件（谱归一化随机投影滤波器和随机化注意力噪声机制）相结合，构造出整体不超过2-Lipschitz的随机网络，在架构内部注入平滑噪声以实现形式化认证。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-1k、NIH Chest X-ray、HAM10000等多个基准上，认证准确率最高提升7.3%（NIH Chest X-ray），经验鲁棒性最高提升3.1%（HAM10000），且不牺牲干净准确率。
AI.conclusion: 随机化的Lipschitz约束架构能够同时提升L2认证鲁棒性和L经验鲁棒性，为高风险场景中深度学习模型的安全部署提供了可行方案。

title: InfoLaw: Information Scaling Laws for Large Language Models with Quality-Weighted Mixture Data and Repetition
summary: Upweighting high-quality data in LLM pretraining often improves performance, but in datalimited regimes, especially under overtraining, stronger upweighting increases repetition and can degrade performance. However, standard scaling laws do not reliably extrapolate across mixture recipes or under repetitions, making the selection for optimal data recipes at scaling underdetermined. To solve this, we introduce InfoLaw (Information Scaling Laws), a data-aware scaling framework that predicts loss from consumed tokens, model size, data mixture weights, and repetition. The key idea is to model pretraining as information accumulation, where quality controls information density and repetition induces scaledependent diminishing returns. We first collect the model performance after training on datasets that vary in scale, quality distribution, and repetition level. Then we build up the modeling for information so that information accurately predicts those model performance. InfoLaw predicts performance on unseen data recipes and larger scale runs (up to 7B, 425B tokens) with 0.15% mean and 0.96% max absolute error in loss, and it extrapolates reliably across overtraining levels, enabling efficient data-recipe selection under varying compute budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfoLaw（信息缩放定律），一种数据感知的缩放框架，通过将预训练建模为信息积累过程，预测损失与数据混合配方、重复次数和模型规模的关系，在7B/425B token规模下实现0.15%平均绝对误差，并支持跨过训练水平的外推。
AI.motivation: 现有缩放定律无法可靠地在不同数据混合配方和重复次数下进行外推，导致在数据受限（尤其是过训练）场景下，难以确定最优数据配方。
AI.method: 将预训练建模为信息积累过程（质量控制信息密度，重复导致规模依赖的边际收益递减）；收集不同规模、质量分布和重复水平的数据集训练模型；构建信息模型使其准确预测模型性能。
AI.result: 在未见过的数据配方和更大规模（7B参数、425B token）上，损失预测的平均绝对误差为0.15%，最大绝对误差为0.96%，且能可靠地跨过训练水平外推。
AI.conclusion: InfoLaw能够高效地在不同计算预算下选择最优数据配方，解决了数据受限过训练场景下的数据选择难题。

title: Complexity Horizons of Compressed Models in Analog Circuit Analysis
summary: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for specialized engineering domains, such as circuit analysis, often faces a trade-off between reasoning accuracy and computational efficiency. Traditional evaluation methods treat model performance as a flat metric, failing to account for the hierarchical nature of engineering knowledge. We propose a performance-aware model compression strategy that utilizes prerequisite graphs to optimize model selection for circuit analysis tasks. By structuring electronics design concepts as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs), we can identify the specific complexity horizons of an LLM's compressed variants' tiers. Our framework introduces an agentic pipeline for generating prerequisite-based datasets and a strategic evaluation engine that dynamically cascades queries across a spectrum of compressed variants of an LLM. This approach allows to select the smallest compressed model, given its conceptual knowledge boundaries in circuit analysis. Experimental results on analog electronics datasets demonstrate that prerequisite graphs provide a granular map of model compression with respect to the performance given circuit analysis complexity. (Source Code: https://github.com/pacomesimon/LLM_prereq_graphs_circuit_analysis, Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/pacomesimon/LLM_prereq_graphs_circuit_analysis)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于先修知识图谱的性能感知模型压缩策略，用于优化大语言模型在电路分析任务中的推理准确性与计算效率权衡。通过将有向无环图（DAG）结构引入先修关系建模，并设计智能体流水线和级联查询引擎，实现自动选择最小压缩模型。实验证明该方法能有效刻画模型压缩与电路分析复杂度之间的粒度映射关系。
AI.motivation: 传统评估方法将模型性能视为平面指标，无法反映工程知识的层次结构；大语言模型在专业工程领域（如电路分析）部署时面临推理准确性与计算效率的权衡问题。
AI.method: 1) 将电子设计概念构建为先修知识有向无环图（DAG）；2) 提出智能体流水线生成基于先修知识的数据集；3) 设计策略评估引擎，动态将查询级联到同一LLM的不同压缩变体；4) 根据模型的概念知识边界选择最小的压缩模型。
AI.result: 在模拟电子数据集上的实验表明，先修知识图谱能提供模型压缩与电路分析复杂度之间性能的细粒度映射关系。
AI.conclusion: 先修知识图谱为理解模型压缩对特定领域性能的影响提供了结构性视角，能够在保持推理准确性的前提下实现计算效率的优化。

title: MIRL: Mutual Information-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently suffer from visual perception errors and hallucinations that compromise answer accuracy in complex reasoning tasks. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising solution by optimizing policies using answer correctness signals. Despite their effectiveness, prevailing RLVR methods face two critical limitations. First, much of the sampling budget is wasted on trajectories doomed to fail due to early visual description errors. Second, sparse rewards cannot distinguish whether failures stem from visual perception or reasoning stages. We introduce MIRL, a decoupled framework that addresses both limitations by leveraging mutual information (MI) between generated descriptions and visual inputs as a cheap pre-screening signal. This enables intelligent budget allocation toward high-potential trajectories via forking, while decoupled training provides independent MI-based rewards for visual perception optimization, resolving reward blindness. Experiments on six vision-language reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MIRL achieves 70.22% average accuracy and successfully surpasses the performance of sampling 16 complete trajectories using only 10 pre-samples with top-6 selection (25% fewer complete trajectories). Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mirl-main/.

AI.tldr: MIRL是一个解耦的强化学习框架，通过互信息作为预筛选信号，智能分配采样预算并解耦视觉感知与推理阶段的奖励，在减少25%完整轨迹的情况下超越传统方法，在六个视觉语言推理基准上达到70.22%的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法在视觉语言模型推理中面临两个关键局限：一是大量采样预算浪费在因早期视觉描述错误而注定失败的轨迹上；二是稀疏奖励无法区分失败源于视觉感知阶段还是推理阶段。
AI.method: 提出MIRL解耦框架：利用生成描述与视觉输入之间的互信息作为廉价预筛选信号，通过forking机制将预算分配给高潜力轨迹；同时采用解耦训练，为视觉感知优化提供独立的基于互信息的奖励，解决奖励盲区问题。
AI.result: 在六个视觉语言推理基准上平均准确率达70.22%，仅用10个预样本和top-6选择（减少25%完整轨迹）即可超越采样16条完整轨迹的性能。
AI.conclusion: MIRL通过互信息驱动的预算分配和解耦奖励机制，有效解决了视觉感知错误和奖励稀疏问题，显著提升了VLM推理的效率和准确性。

title: Is It Novel and Why? Fine-Grained Patent Novelty Prediction Based on Passage Retrieval
summary: Novelty assessment is a critical yet complex task in the examination process for patent acceptance, requiring examiners to determine whether an invention is disclosed in a prior art document. The process involves intricate matching between specific features of a patent claim and passages in the prior art. While prior work has approached novelty prediction primarily as a binary classification task at the claim level, we argue that this formulation is susceptible to spurious correlations and lacks the granularity required for practical application. In this work, we introduce FiNE-Patents (Fine-grained Novelty Examination of Patents), a novel dataset comprising 3,658 first patent claims annotated with fine-grained, feature-level prior art references extracted from European Search Opinion (ESOP) documents. We propose shifting the evaluation paradigm from simple binary classification to a joint retrieval and abstract reasoning task at the feature level, requiring models to identify specific passages from a prior art document that disclose individual claim features, and to identify which features of a claim make it novel. We implement and evaluate LLM-based workflows that decompose claims into features, analyze each feature against prior art, and finally derive a claim-level novelty prediction. Our experiments demonstrate that these workflows outperform embedding-based baselines on passage retrieval and novel feature identification. Furthermore, we show that unlike trained classifiers, LLMs are robust against spurious correlations present in the claim-level novelty classification task. We release the dataset and code to foster further research into transparent and granular patent analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FiNE-Patents数据集，将专利新颖性评估从粗粒度的二元分类任务转变为细粒度的特征级检索与推理任务，并验证了基于LLM的工作流在此任务上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有专利新颖性预测方法多为粗粒度的二元分类，易受虚假相关影响且缺乏实际应用所需的细粒度信息，无法满足专利审查中特征级匹配的实际需求。
AI.method: 构建了包含3,658个专利首项权利要求的FiNE-Patents数据集，标注了细粒度的特征级现有技术引用；设计了LLM工作流，将权利要求分解为特征，逐个分析特征与现有技术的匹配关系，最终推导出权利要求级的新颖性预测。
AI.result: LLM工作流在段落检索和新颖特征识别任务上优于基于嵌入的基线方法；LLM相比传统分类器对虚假相关更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将新颖性评估重新定义为联合检索与抽象推理任务，LLM工作流在细粒度专利分析中表现更优，数据集和代码已开源。

title: EngiAgent: Fully Connected Coordination of LLM Agents for Solving Open-ended Engineering Problems with Feasible Solutions
summary: Engineering problem solving is central to real-world decision-making, requiring mathematical formulations that not only represent complex problems but also produce feasible solutions under data and physical constraints. Unlike mathematical problem solving, which operates on predefined formulations, engineering tasks demand open-ended analysis, feasibility-driven modeling, and iterative refinement. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in reasoning and code generation, they often fail to ensure feasibility, which limits their applicability to engineering problem solving. To address this challenge, we propose EngiAgent, a multi-agent system with a fully connected coordinator that simulates expert workflows through specialized agents for problem analysis, modeling, verification, solving, and solution evaluation. The fully connected coordinator enables flexible feedback routing, overcoming the rigidity of prior pipeline-based reflection methods and ensuring feasibility at every stage of the process. This design not only improves robustness to diverse failure cases such as data extraction errors, constraint inconsistencies, and solver failures, but also enhances the overall quality of problem solving. Empirical results across four representative domains demonstrate that EngiAgent achieves substantial improvements in feasibility compared to prior approaches, establishing a new paradigm for feasibility-oriented engineering problem solving with LLMs. Our source code and data are available at https://github.com/AI4Engi/EngiAgent.

AI.tldr: EngiAgent是一个多智能体系统，通过全连接协调器模拟专家工作流，在工程问题求解中显著提升可行性，克服了传统管道式反思方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在工程问题求解中缺乏可行性保障，难以处理开放式分析、数据与物理约束下的可行解生成。
AI.method: 提出EngiAgent多智能体系统，包含问题分析、建模、验证、求解和方案评估五个专业智能体，通过全连接协调器实现灵活的反馈路由，确保各阶段可行性。
AI.result: 在四个代表性工程领域上的实验表明，EngiAgent在可行性方面显著优于已有方法。
AI.conclusion: EngiAgent为面向可行性的工程问题求解建立了新范式，证明了全连接协调器设计在提升鲁棒性和求解质量方面的有效性。

title: Robust Fundamental Matrix Estimation from Single Image Motion Blur
summary: In this paper, we introduce a challenging task: extracting a fundamental matrix from a single motion blurred image. For a camera moving in 3D during exposure, the smear paths in the blurry image contain cues and constraints on this motion. We demonstrate the feasibility of establishing correspondences between two time instances within the camera exposure window, and that these can be used to robustly infer a fundamental matrix, which summarizes the motion of the camera during the exposure time. The inferred fundamental matrix is unique up to a transpose, corresponding to an ambiguity of the direction of time. Due to this per-smear ambiguity, classic methods, such as the 8-point algorithm, are no longer usable. The proposed method modifies the estimation to work on time-direction ambiguous correspondences. To improve the robustness of the fundamental matrix estimation, we also propose to incorporate an uncertainty measurement in smear pattern prediction and use it in the sampling process of the estimator. Experiments on synthetic and real-world motion-blur datasets demonstrate that our approach is able to estimate the fundamental matrix encoding the 3D camera motion, from single frames. Practical applicability is demonstrated on the downstream task of motion segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从单张运动模糊图像中提取基础矩阵（Fundamental Matrix）的新任务与方法，通过模糊轨迹中的对应关系推断相机在曝光期间的3D运动，并解决了时间方向模糊性问题。
AI.motivation: 传统方法需要多张图像或清晰图像才能估计基础矩阵，而本文旨在从单张运动模糊图像中直接提取相机3D运动信息，拓展了运动模糊图像的应用范围。
AI.method: 利用曝光窗口内两个时间点之间的对应关系，结合不确定性度量改进采样过程，修改经典8点算法以处理时间方向模糊的对应点，最终鲁棒地推断基础矩阵。
AI.result: 在合成和真实运动模糊数据集上验证了方法的有效性，能够从单帧图像中估计编码3D相机运动的基础矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 提出方法成功实现了从单张运动模糊图像中估计基础矩阵，并在运动分割等下游任务中展示了实用性。

title: Distilling Long-CoT Reasoning through Collaborative Step-wise Multi-Teacher Decoding
summary: Distilling large reasoning models is essential for making Long-CoT reasoning practical, as full-scale inference remains computationally prohibitive. Existing curation-based approaches select complete reasoning traces post-hoc, overlooking collaboration among heterogeneous teachers and lacking dynamic exploration, which leads to redundant sampling and missed complementary reasoning. We introduce CoRD, a collaborative multi-teacher decoding framework that performs step-wise reasoning synthesis guided by predictive perplexity-based scoring and beam search. This enables heterogeneous LRMs to jointly construct coherent reasoning trajectories while efficiently preserving diverse, high-potential hypotheses. Experiments show that CoRD produces higher-quality reasoning data and achieves near teacher-level student performance with fewer, structured supervision signals, without substantial efficiency overhead. CoRD further generalizes well to out-of-domain and open-ended settings. The dataset and model are available at \href{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/CoRD}{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/CoRD}.

AI.tldr: CoRD是一种多教师协作解码框架，通过基于困惑度评分的波束搜索逐步合成推理轨迹，高效生成高质量的长思维链推理数据，使学生模型在较少监督下达到接近教师水平的性能，且泛化能力强。
AI.motivation: 现有基于筛选的方法只能事后选择完整推理轨迹，忽视了异构教师间的协作，缺乏动态探索，导致冗余采样和互补推理的遗漏。
AI.method: 提出CoRD框架，采用多教师协作解码，通过预测性困惑度评分和波束搜索进行逐步推理合成，使异构大推理模型联合构建连贯推理轨迹，同时高效保留多样化的高潜力假设。
AI.result: CoRD生成更高质量的推理数据，在较少结构化监督信号下使学生模型达到接近教师水平的性能，且效率开销低；在域外和开放场景中也有良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CoRD通过多教师协作解码有效解决了长思维链推理的蒸馏难题，是一种高效、可泛化的推理数据合成方法。

title: HalluScan: A Systematic Benchmark for Detecting and Mitigating Hallucinations in Instruction-Following LLMs
comment: 38 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to Neural Computing and Applications
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse natural language processing tasks, yet they remain susceptible to hallucinations -- generating content that is factually incorrect, unfaithful to provided context, or misaligned with user instructions. We present HalluScan, a comprehensive benchmark framework that systematically evaluates hallucination detection and mitigation across 72 configurations spanning 6 detection methods, 4 open-weight model families, and 3 diverse domains. We introduce three key contributions: (1) HalluScore, a novel composite metric that achieves a Pearson correlation of r = 0.41 with human expert judgments; (2) Adaptive Detection Routing (ADR), an intelligent routing algorithm achieving 2.0x cost reduction with only 0.1% AUROC degradation; and (3) systematic error cascade decomposition revealing substantial variation in hallucination error types across domains. Our experiments reveal that NLI Verification achieves the highest overall AUROC of 0.88, while RAV achieves the second-highest AUROC of 0.66.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HalluScan基准框架，系统评估大语言模型的幻觉检测与缓解方法，包含6种检测方法、4种模型家族和3个领域共72种配置。主要贡献包括：HalluScore复合指标（与人类判断的Pearson相关系数r=0.41）、自适应检测路由ADR（成本降低2.0倍，AUROC仅下降0.1%）、以及跨领域错误级联分解分析。实验表明NLI Verification达到最高AUROC 0.88，RAV次之0.66。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多种NLP任务中表现优异，但仍存在生成事实错误、不忠实于上下文或与用户指令不符的幻觉问题。缺乏系统性评估幻觉检测与缓解方法的基准框架。
AI.method: 构建了HalluScan基准框架，包含72种配置（6种检测方法×4个模型家族×3个领域）；提出HalluScore复合评估指标、自适应检测路由（ADR）算法、以及错误级联分解分析方法。
AI.result: HalluScore与人类专家判断的Pearson相关系数为0.41；ADR实现2.0倍成本降低且AUROC仅下降0.1%；NLI Verification达到最高AUROC 0.88，RAV为0.66；不同领域的幻觉错误类型存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: HalluScan为幻觉检测与缓解提供了系统化评估框架，NLI Verification是目前最优检测方法，ADR在成本与性能间实现了良好平衡，且不同领域需针对性处理不同类型的幻觉错误。

title: Anon: Extrapolating Optimizer Adaptivity Across the Real Spectrum
summary: Adaptive optimizers such as Adam have achieved great success in training large-scale models like large language models and diffusion models. However, they often generalize worse than non-adaptive methods, such as SGD on classical architectures like CNNs. We identify a key cause of this performance gap: adaptivity in pre-conditioners, which limits the optimizer's ability to adapt to diverse optimization landscapes. To address this, we propose Anon (Adaptivity Non-restricted Optimizer with Novel convergence technique), a novel optimizer with continuously tunable adaptivity in R, allowing it to interpolate between SGD-like and Adam-like behaviors and even extrapolate beyond both. To ensure convergence across the entire adaptivity spectrum, we introduce incremental delay update (IDU), a novel mechanism that is more flexible than AMSGrad's hard max-tracking strategy and enhances robustness to gradient noise. We theoretically establish convergence guarantees under both convex and non-convex settings. Empirically, Anon consistently outperforms state-of-the-art optimizers on representative image classification, diffusion, and language modeling tasks. These results demonstrate that adaptivity can serve as a valuable tunable design principle, and Anon provides the first unified and reliable framework capable of bridging the gap between classical and modern optimizers and surpassing their advantageous properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anon优化器，通过可连续调节的自适应机制，在SGD和Adam之间灵活插值，并引入增量延迟更新（IDU）确保收敛，在图像分类、扩散模型和语言建模任务上均超越现有优化器。
AI.motivation: 自适应优化器（如Adam）在大规模模型训练中表现优异，但泛化能力往往不如非自适应方法（如SGD）。作者识别出这一性能差距的关键原因在于预条件子的自适应能力限制了优化器适应多样化优化景观的能力。
AI.method: 提出Anon优化器，具备连续可调的自适应度参数，可在SGD和Adam行为之间插值甚至外推；引入增量延迟更新（IDU）机制，比AMSGrad的硬最大追踪更灵活，增强对梯度噪声的鲁棒性；在凸与非凸设置下均提供收敛保证。
AI.result: 在图像分类、扩散模型和语言建模任务上，Anon一致优于现有最先进优化器。
AI.conclusion: 自适应度可作为有价值且可调节的设计原则，Anon是首个能够统一桥接经典与现代优化器并超越其优势属性的可靠框架。

title: Unifying Deep Stochastic Processes for Image Enhancement
comment: 27 pages, in proceesings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Deep stochastic processes have recently become a central paradigm for image enhancement, with many methods explicitly conditioning the stochastic trajectory on the degraded input. However, the relationship between these conditional processes and standard diffusion models remains unclear. In this work, we introduce a unified perspective on stochastic image enhancement by classifying recent methods into three families of continuous-time processes: unconditional diffusion models, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes, and diffusion bridges. We show that all of these approaches arise from a common stochastic differential equation (SDE) formulation. This framework makes explicit that seemingly disparate methods differ primarily in their drift and diffusion terms, terminal distributions, and boundary conditions, while schedulers and samplers constitute orthogonal design choices. Leveraging this unification, we conduct a controlled empirical study across multiple image enhancement tasks using identical architectures and training protocols. Our results reveal no consistently dominant method; instead, we identify and disentangle the specific design choices that most strongly influence performance. Finally, we release ItoVision, a modular PyTorch library that implements the unified framework and enables rapid prototyping and fair comparison of stochastic image enhancement methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一随机微分方程（SDE）框架，将多种随机图像增强方法（无条件扩散模型、Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程、扩散桥）纳入同一视角，并通过大规模实证研究揭示了影响性能的关键设计选择。
AI.motivation: 现有随机图像增强方法虽然基于深度随机过程，但不同方法之间的内在关系尚不明确，缺乏统一的视角来理解和比较它们。
AI.method: 将随机图像增强方法分类为三个连续时间过程家族：无条件扩散模型、Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程和扩散桥，并证明它们源自共同的SDE公式，区别仅在于漂移项、扩散项、终端分布和边界条件。
AI.result: 实验表明没有一种方法在所有任务中持续占优；研究识别并解耦了对性能影响最大的具体设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 统一框架有助于理解不同方法的本质联系，同时ItoVision库的发布为未来研究提供了标准化比较平台。

title: PC-MNet: Dual-Level Congruity Modeling for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection via Polarity-Modulated Attention
summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection, which aims to precisely identify pragmatic incongruities between literal text and nonverbal cues, has gained substantial attention in multimodal understanding. Recent advancements have predominantly relied on naïve similarity-based attention mechanisms and uniform late fusion strategies.Furthermore, given that functional entanglement restricts traditional late fusions, we incorporate a scalar congruity routing mechanism and a prior-guided contextual graph. This mechanism anchors a generalized incongruity manifold through a two-stage asymmetric optimization driven by inconsistency-aware contrastive learning, selectively fusing only the most discriminative multi-granularity evidence. Extensive experiments on the \texttt{MUStARD} benchmark and its spurious-correlation-mitigated balanced datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves new state-of-the-art performance, surpassing the strongest multimodal baseline by a substantial 3.14\% improvement in Macro-F1. By architecturally isolating atomic, composition, and contextual conflicts. This work provides a robust, decoupled paradigm for modeling subtle pragmatic incongruities in human communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于标量一致性路由机制和先验引导上下文图的多模态讽刺检测方法，通过不一致性感知对比学习实现两阶段非对称优化，在MUStARD基准上超越现有最佳方法3.14% Macro-F1。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖基于相似性的注意力机制和统一晚期融合策略，存在功能纠缠问题，难以有效捕捉文本与非语言线索之间的语用不协调性。
AI.method: 提出标量一致性路由机制（scalar congruity routing mechanism）和先验引导上下文图（prior-guided contextual graph），通过不一致性感知对比学习驱动的两阶段非对称优化，选择性融合最具判别力的多粒度证据。
AI.result: 在MUStARD基准及其去偏平衡数据集上取得新SOTA，相比最强多模态基线在Macro-F1上提升3.14%。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构上分离原子冲突、组合冲突和上下文冲突，为建模人类交流中微妙的语用不协调性提供了鲁棒且解耦的范式。

title: Can Causal Discovery Algorithms Help in Generating Legal Arguments?
summary: In 2011, Judea Pearl received the Turing Award, considered the Nobel Prize in Computing, for fundamental contributions to artificial intelligence through the development of a calculus for probabilistic and causal reasoning. It includes pioneering the development of causal discovery algorithms. These computer algorithms can analyze large multivariate datasets and automatically discover the causal relationships among the constituent variables. They have been widely used in many critical fields such as medicine and economics to support decisions. However, to our knowledge, they have not been leveraged in law. This paper attempts to alleviate this gap by investigating whether causal discovery algorithms can be leveraged for automated generation of legal arguments. To that end, a novel legal dataset is prepared by identifying 17 legal concepts, such as physical assault and property dispute. A curated collection of 150 homicide cases are annotated with these concepts, e.g., a case is annotated with physical assault only if a physical assault had been reported in that case. Subsequently, a selected set of widely-used causal discovery algorithms is applied to the annotated dataset to discover the causal relationships between the legal concepts. Additionally, the degrees of belief associated with the discovered relationships are quantified in mathematical probabilities. It is shown that some of the causal relationships help generate viable legal arguments, e.g., if one could establish that a physical assault has not taken place during a homicide, it should be a sufficient condition (with probability 1) to establish that the homicide has not been committed due to a property-related dispute. Thus, this paper shows that causal discovery algorithms can be helpful in generating legal arguments, opening up avenues for promising future endeavors.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将因果发现算法应用于法律领域，通过分析150起凶杀案标注数据，成功发现法律概念间的因果关系，可用于自动生成法律论证，例如证明未发生人身攻击即可排除财产纠纷动机（概率为1）。
AI.motivation: 因果发现算法已在医学、经济学等关键领域广泛应用，但尚未被引入法律领域。作者希望填补这一空白，探索是否可以利用因果发现算法自动生成法律论证。
AI.method: 识别17个法律概念（如人身攻击、财产纠纷），对150起凶杀案进行概念标注；应用多种经典因果发现算法分析标注数据，发现概念间的因果关系；用数学概率量化发现关系的置信度。
AI.result: 部分发现的因果关系可生成有效的法律论证，例如：若凶杀案中未发生人身攻击，则足以排除财产纠纷动机（概率为1）。
AI.conclusion: 因果发现算法在法律论证生成中具有应用潜力，为未来相关研究开辟了新方向。

title: Omni-Fake: Benchmarking Unified Multimodal Social Media Deepfake Detection
summary: Multimodal deepfakes are proliferating on social media and threaten authenticity, information integrity, and digital forensics. Existing benchmarks are constrained by their single-modality scope, simplified manipulations, or unrealistic distributions, which limit their ability to assess real-world robustness. To address these limitations, we present Omni-Fake, a unified omni-dataset for comprehensive multimodal deepfake detection in social-media settings. It comprises Omni-Fake-Set, a large-scale, high-quality dataset with 1M+ samples, and Omni-Fake-OOD, an out-of-distribution benchmark with 200k+ samples intentionally excluded from training to evaluate generalization. Omni-Fake spans four modalities (image, audio, video, and audio-video talking head) and supports a joint detection-localization-explanation protocol. On top of Omni-Fake, we further propose Omni-Fake-R1, a reinforcement-learning-driven multimodal detector that adaptively integrates visual and auditory cues and outputs structured decisions, localization, and natural-language explanations. Extensive experiments show significant gains in detection accuracy, cross-modal generalization, and explainability over state-of-the-art baselines. Project page: https://tianxiao1201.github.io/omni-fake-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出了一个统一的多模态深度伪造数据集Omni-Fake（含100万+样本）和基于强化学习的检测器Omni-Fake-R1，在多模态检测、跨模态泛化和可解释性上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造基准存在单模态局限、操作简单或分布不真实的问题，无法有效评估真实场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建了Omni-Fake数据集（包含Omni-Fake-Set和Omni-Fake-OOD），覆盖图像、音频、视频和音视频说话人头四种模态，支持检测-定位-解释联合协议；并提出Omni-Fake-R1，一种基于强化学习的多模态检测器，能自适应融合视觉和听觉线索，输出结构化决策、定位和自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在检测精度、跨模态泛化和可解释性方面显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Fake及其检测器为社交媒体环境下的多模态深度伪造检测提供了更全面、更真实的评估基准和有效解决方案。

title: ANO: A Principled Approach to Robust Policy Optimization
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) dominates deep RL but faces a fundamental dilemma. Its "hard clipping" mechanism discards valuable gradient information from outliers, leading to sample inefficiency. Conversely, removing clipping (as in SPO) exposes optimization to unbounded gradients, causing significant instability and hyperparameter sensitivity. To resolve this, we establish a Unified Trust Region Framework that generalizes existing objectives. Within this framework, we derive Anchored Neighborhood Optimization (ANO) based on a set of design principles. We identify that the failure of standard policy gradients stems from a misapplication of gradient influence on outliers. We propose the Redescending Influence Principle, a paradigm shift from monotonic penalties (SPO) and hard-thresholding (PPO) to dynamic outlier suppression, and prove its necessity for stability in high-variance stochastic optimization. Theoretically, we prove ANO possesses the minimal structural complexity required for robust optimization. Empirically, ANO achieves state-of-the-art performance on MuJoCo benchmarks, significantly outperforming PPO and SPO. Notably, ANO demonstrates superior stability, preventing policy collapse even under aggressive hyperparameters (e.g., learning rates 3x larger than standard) where PPO fails completely.

AI.tldr: 针对PPO硬裁剪丢弃梯度信息导致样本低效、SPO无裁剪导致不稳定问题，本文提出统一信任域框架，并导出基于红降影响原则的锚定邻域优化（ANO），实现动态异常值抑制，在MuJoCo基准上达到SOTA性能，且对激进超参数具有卓越稳定性。
AI.motivation: 解决PPO的硬裁剪机制丢弃异常值梯度信息导致样本效率低下，以及SPO无裁剪导致优化不稳定和超参数敏感这一两难困境。
AI.method: 建立统一信任域框架泛化现有目标函数；提出红降影响原则，从单调惩罚（SPO）和硬阈值（PPO）转向动态异常值抑制；推导出锚定邻域优化（ANO）。
AI.result: ANO在MuJoCo基准上显著优于PPO和SPO，达到SOTA性能；在超参数为标准3倍的情况下仍能保持稳定，而PPO完全失败。
AI.conclusion: ANO具有鲁棒优化所需的最小结构复杂度，红降影响原则是高方差随机优化中稳定性的必要条件。

title: SteeringDiffusion: A Bottlenecked Activation Control Interface for Diffusion Models
summary: We introduce SteeringDiffusion, a bottlenecked activation-level control interface for diffusion models that exposes a smooth, monotonic, and runtime-adjustable control surface over the content--style trade-off. Our method keeps the U-Net backbone frozen and learns a small, prompt-conditioned latent code projected to FiLM/AdaGN-style modulation parameters. A zero-initialized design guarantees exact equivalence to the base model at zero scale, while timestep-aware gating restricts modulation to later denoising stages. A single scalar at inference continuously traverses the control surface without retraining. Across experiments on Stable Diffusion~1.5 and SDXL covering multiple artistic styles, we show that SteeringDiffusion produces smooth and monotonic content--style trade-offs. Under matched parameter budgets, it outperforms LoRA in controllability and stability, while ControlNet and rank-1 adapters do not expose a comparable control surface. We further introduce an inversion-stability diagnostic based on DDIM inversion, used as a post-hoc trajectory probe, which reveals strong correlations with intervention magnitude. These results position \emph{Steering Bottlenecked Explicit Control (S-BEC)} as a practical, general-purpose control interface for frozen diffusion backbones.

AI.tldr: SteeringDiffusion 提出了一种基于瓶颈层的激活级控制接口，通过在冻结的 U-Net 骨干网络后添加零初始化的提示条件潜在编码，实现对扩散模型内容-风格权衡的平滑、单调且可运行时调节的控制。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型缺乏一种能够在不重训练情况下，平滑且单调地调节内容与风格之间权衡的通用控制接口。
AI.method: 在冻结的 U-Net 骨干网络后学习一个小的、提示条件潜在编码，映射为 FiLM/AdaGN 风格的调制参数；采用零初始化设计确保零尺度时与基模型完全等价；引入时间步感知门控限制调制仅作用于后期去噪阶段。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 1.5 和 SDXL 上，SteeringDiffusion 实现了平滑单调的内容-风格权衡；在相同参数预算下，其可控性和稳定性优于 LoRA，而 ControlNet 和 rank-1 adapter 无法提供类似的控制表面。
AI.conclusion: 提出了 Steering Bottlenecked Explicit Control (S-BEC) 作为冻结扩散骨干网络的通用控制接口，具有实用性和通用性。

title: ATLAS: Article Tracking, Linking, and Analysis of Swedish Encyclopedias
summary: The digitization of old encyclopedias represents an important step to improve access to historically structured knowledge. Often, however, this process does not go beyond an optical character recognition, leaving all the underlying structure unexploited. In addition, many encyclopedias had multiple editions reflecting the evolution of knowledge. The lack of structure in the raw text makes it difficult to track changes across these editions. In this work, we built a pipeline to restore the text structure, where we extract the headwords and identify entries; categorize the entities; match entries across editions; and link entries to a Wikidata item. We applied this pipeline to the four major editions of \textit{Nordisk familjebok}, an authoritative Swedish encyclopedia published between 1876 and 1951. We could extract the headwords with an F1 score of 97.8\% and we obtained an F1 score of 93.4\% on the headword classification. On a small-scale evaluation, we reached a 93\% precision on the cross-edition matching, 85\% precision and 16.5\% recall on the Wikidata linking. This shows that an automated approach to digitized historical knowledge is possible. This should facilitate the preservation of general knowledge and the understanding of knowledge transmission. The datasets and programs are available online.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个自动化流水线，用于恢复数字化百科全书的文本结构，包括提取词条、分类实体、跨版本匹配以及与Wikidata链接，并在瑞典百科全书《Nordisk familjebok》的四个主要版本上取得了良好效果。
AI.motivation: 旧百科全书的数字化通常仅停留在OCR层面，未利用其底层结构，且多版本间的知识演化难以追踪，亟需一种自动化方法恢复文本结构并实现跨版本比较。
AI.method: 构建了一套流水线：提取词条并识别条目；对实体进行分类；跨版本匹配条目；将条目链接到Wikidata项目。应用于《Nordisk familjebok》的四个主要版本（1876-1951）。
AI.result: 词条提取F1分数97.8%，词条分类F1分数93.4%；跨版本匹配精确率93%，Wikidata链接精确率85%、召回率16.5%。
AI.conclusion: 自动化方法处理数字化历史知识是可行的，有助于知识的保存与传播理解。

title: A Compound AI Agent for Conversational Grant Discovery
comment: accepted as demo submission to ACM CAIS
summary: Research funding discovery remains fundamentally fragmented: researchers navigate disparate agency portals (e.g., in the United States, NSF, NIH, DARPA, Grants.gov, and many others) with heterogeneous interfaces, search capabilities, and data schemas. We present a compound AI system that unifies this landscape through two tightly coupled components: (1) an aggregation layer that autonomously collects, normalizes, and indexes almost 12,000 federal and nonprofit opportunities from fragmented sources via LLM-equipped browser agents, maintaining a biweekly-updated unified database; and (2) an agentic ReAct-based query processing layer that interprets research context (including from PDF documents) and employs hybrid search combining a structured index with selective web search to retrieve relevant opportunities - while avoiding LLM hallucination. The conversational interface supports iterative refinement through multi-turn interactions, allowing researchers to progressively apply constraints without reformulating their core research description. Results stream in real time with full transparency of intermediate reasoning, enabling appropriate calibration of user trust. Currently used by almost 3,000+ users, our approach demonstrates the feasibility of compound AI in reducing grant discovery time from 30--45 minutes (manual, fragmented portal searches) to under 10 minutes (unified, conversational search).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个复合AI系统，通过LLM驱动的浏览器代理自动聚合近12,000个联邦和非营利资助机会，并结合基于ReAct的对话式查询处理层，将资助发现时间从30-45分钟缩短至10分钟以内，已被近3000名用户使用。
AI.motivation: 研究人员目前需要访问多个异构的资助门户网站（如NSF、NIH、DARPA、Grants.gov等），这些网站具有不同的界面、搜索功能和数据模式，导致科研经费发现过程高度碎片化且效率低下。
AI.method: 构建一个复合AI系统，包含两个紧密耦合的组件：(1) 聚合层：使用配备LLM的浏览器代理自动收集、标准化和索引来自分散来源的近12,000个资助机会，维护每两周更新的统一数据库；(2) 基于ReAct的查询处理层：解释研究上下文（包括PDF文档），采用结合结构化索引与选择性网络搜索的混合检索方法，支持多轮对话迭代优化查询，并实时流式输出结果及中间推理过程。
AI.result: 该方法将资助发现时间从手动检索多个碎片化门户所需的30-45分钟，缩短至统一对话式搜索的10分钟以内，目前已服务近3000名用户。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了复合AI系统在解决科研资助发现碎片化问题上的可行性，通过自动化聚合与智能对话搜索显著提升了效率，且实时透明的推理过程有助于用户建立适当信任。

title: Act2See: Emergent Active Visual Perception for Video Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) typically rely on static initial frames for video reasoning, restricting their ability to incorporate essential dynamic information as the reasoning process evolves. Existing methods that augment Chain-of-Thought (CoT) with additional frame information often exhibit suboptimal CoT quality and lack the crucial ability to synthesize visual information for hypothetical or counterfactual scenarios. We introduce Act-to-See (Act2See), a novel framework that enables active visual perception by empowering VLMs to actively interleave video frames within text CoTs. Act2See is developed via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a high-quality dataset of reasoning traces generated by a frontier VLM. These traces integrate active calls to either retrieve existing frames or generate new ones, and are rigorously verified against human-annotated CoTs to ensure quality. This approach cultivates an emergent capability: at inference time, the model actively determines when to search for or synthesize the necessary visual evidence. Act2See establishes new state-of-the-art results on challenging benchmarks, including VideoEspresso and ViTIB, and outperforms comparable or larger models on Video-MME, EgoNormia, and VCR-Bench, demonstrating an advancement in enabling VLMs with active visual perception for video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Act2See框架，让视觉语言模型在视频推理中主动穿插和合成帧，超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM依赖静态初始帧进行视频推理，缺乏动态信息；增强CoT的方法质量次优，且无法合成假设/反事实场景的视觉信息。
AI.method: 通过SFT在高质量推理轨迹数据集上训练，这些轨迹包含主动检索或生成帧的调用，并经过人工标注CoT验证。模型在推理时自主决定何时搜索或合成视觉证据。
AI.result: 在VideoEspresso、ViTIB上达到SOTA；在Video-MME、EgoNormia、VCR-Bench上超越同等或更大模型。
AI.conclusion: Act2See实现了VLM的主动视觉感知能力，推动了视频推理的进步。

title: Accurate Legal Reasoning at Scale: Neuro-Symbolic Offloading and Structural Auditability for Robust Legal Adjudication
comment: 14 pages (7 pages main text), 3 figures. Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026) - Industry Track
summary: Legal texts often contain computational legal clauses--provisions whose understanding requires complex logic. While frontier Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) can describe such clauses, building production-ready systems is limited by reasoning errors and the high cost of inference. We propose Amortized Intelligence, a neuro-symbolic approach where we use an LLM once to translate a legal text into Deterministic Autonomous Contract Language (DACL): a typed graph intermediate representation. Adjudication then relies on deterministic graph executions with a visually auditable trace. In comparison against runtime LRM baselines (including GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro), our DACL-based Agent achieves near-perfect consistency and mitigates the "reasoning cliff" observed in probabilistic models. The system reduces compute costs by over 90% in high-volume workflows while satisfying the strict auditability requirements of legal adjudication.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为"摊销智能"的神经符号方法，通过将法律文本一次性翻译为确定性自主合约语言（DACL）图中间表示，然后依赖确定性图执行进行裁决，相比运行时大推理模型（LRM）基线，实现了接近完美的一致性，降低了90%以上的计算成本，并满足法律裁决的严格可审计性要求。
AI.motivation: 法律文本包含计算性法律条款，理解这些条款需要复杂逻辑。现有前沿大推理模型虽然能够描述这些条款，但构建生产级系统受到推理错误和高推理成本的限制。因此，需要一种更高效、更可靠且可审计的方法。
AI.method: 提出摊销智能（Amortized Intelligence），一种神经符号方法：使用LLM一次性将法律文本翻译为确定性自主合约语言（DACL）——一种类型化图中间表示。裁决阶段则依赖确定性图执行，并生成可视化可审计的追踪轨迹。
AI.result: 与运行时LRM基线（包括GPT-5.2和Gemini 3 Pro）相比，基于DACL的Agent实现了接近完美的一致性，缓解了概率模型中观察到的"推理悬崖"问题；在高吞吐量工作流中计算成本降低超过90%；同时满足法律裁决的严格可审计性要求。
AI.conclusion: 摊销智能方法通过在前期一次性翻译成本替代每次推理的高成本，结合确定性执行和可视化审计追踪，为实现生产级法律文本自动化处理提供了一种高效、可靠且可审计的解决方案。

title: Controllable and Verifiable Process Data Synthesis for Process Reward Models
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) rely on high-quality process supervision data, yet existing construction methods often provide limited control over error location, error type, and trajectory consistency. We propose a controllable and verifiable framework for synthesizing process supervision data for PRMs. Our framework first constructs a correct symbolic reasoning chain, injects a template-aware error into an intermediate step, recomputes subsequent steps under the corrupted state, and verifies that the injected step is not derivable from its prefix. The resulting paired trajectories are prefix-invalid at the first error while remaining trajectory-consistent after symbolic recomputation, and are translated into aligned natural-language processes for PRM training and evaluation. Experiments show that the synthesized data improve Best-of-8 reranking on logical reasoning benchmarks and transfer to mathematical reasoning. Step-level evaluation further shows that first-error localization remains substantially more challenging than overall step classification, highlighting the need for fine-grained and verifiable process supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可控可验证的框架，通过符号推理链注入错误并验证前缀无效性，合成高质量过程监督数据用于训练过程奖励模型（PRM）。
AI.motivation: 现有PRM的过程监督数据构建方法对错误位置、错误类型和轨迹一致性的控制有限，导致监督数据质量不高。
AI.method: 先构建正确的符号推理链，在中间步骤注入模板感知的错误，在错误状态下重新计算后续步骤，验证注入步骤不可由其前缀推导得出，最后将生成的轨迹对转化为对齐的自然语言过程。
AI.result: 合成的数据在逻辑推理基准上提升了Best-of-8重排序性能，并能迁移到数学推理任务；首次错误定位比整体步骤分类更具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 验证了细粒度、可验证的过程监督对于提升PRM性能的重要性，指出首次错误准确定位仍是关键难点。

title: A multilingual hallucination benchmark: MultiWikiQHalluA
summary: Most hallucination evaluations focus on English, leaving it unclear whether findings transfer to lower-resource languages. We investigate faithfulness hallucinations, defined as model-generated content that is fluent and plausible but diverges from the provided input or is internally inconsistent. Leveraging the multilingual MultiWikiQA dataset, we utilize the LettuceDetect framework to create synthetic hallucination datasets for 306 languages, from which we train token-level hallucination classifiers for 30 European languages. In this work, we present evaluations of model hallucinations on a selection of languages: English, Danish, German, and Icelandic. Using these classifiers, we evaluate the hallucination rates for Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-14B, Gemma-3-12B-IT, cogito-v1-preview-qwen-32B, and cogito-v1-preview-llama-70B. Our classifiers reveal notably higher hallucination rates for Qwen3-0.6B (up to 60\% of answers containing at least one hallucination, peaking in Icelandic) and generally lower rates for larger models, with cogito-v1-preview-qwen-32B and cogito-v1-preview-llama-70B performing best on most languages. Hallucination rates are consistently higher for lower-resource languages, particularly Icelandic.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对306种语言构建幻觉分类器，评估了多语言模型在英语、丹麦语、德语和冰岛语上的幻觉率，发现低资源语言（尤其是冰岛语）幻觉率更高，大模型表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉评估多集中于英语，缺乏对低资源语言的研究，因此需要探索多语言环境下的模型幻觉表现。
AI.method: 利用MultiWikiQA数据集和LettuceDetect框架，为306种语言合成幻觉数据集，训练了30种欧洲语言的词级幻觉分类器，并评估了Qwen3-0.6B、Qwen3-14B、Gemma-3-12B-IT、cogito-v1-preview-qwen-32B和cogito-v1-preview-llama-70B五个模型。
AI.result: Qwen3-0.6B幻觉率最高（高达60%），冰岛语最严重；大模型表现更好，cogito系列在多数语言上最佳；低资源语言幻觉率普遍更高。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模越大幻觉率越低，低资源语言的幻觉问题更突出，需进一步关注多语言幻觉评估与缓解。

title: HeavySkill: Heavy Thinking as the Inner Skill in Agentic Harness
summary: Recent advances in agentic harness with orchestration frameworks that coordinate multiple agents with memory, skills, and tool use have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks. However, the underlying mechanism that truly drives performance remains obscured behind intricate system designs. In this paper, we propose HeavySkill, a perspective that views heavy thinking not only as a minimal execution unit in orchestration harness but also as an inner skill internalized within the model's parameters that drives the orchestrator to solve complex tasks. We identify this skill as a two-stage pipeline, i.e., parallel reasoning then summarization, which can operate beneath any agentic harness. We present a systematic empirical study of HeavySkill across diverse domains. Our results show that this inner skill consistently outperforms traditional Best-of-N (BoN) strategies; notably, stronger LLMs can even approach Pass@N performance. Crucially, we demonstrate that the depth and width of heavy thinking, as a learnable skill, can be further scaled via reinforcement learning, offering a promising path toward self-evolving LLMs that internalize complex reasoning without relying on brittle orchestration layers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HeavySkill视角，认为深度思考是一种内化于模型参数中的技能（并行推理+总结），可替代复杂的外部编排框架，通过强化学习可进一步扩展，优于传统BoN策略。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent编排框架在复杂推理任务中表现优异，但其性能提升的真正机制被复杂的系统设计所掩盖，作者希望揭示并简化这一核心机制。
AI.method: 提出HeavySkill概念，将深度思考视为模型内化的两阶段技能（并行推理→总结），并通过强化学习对思考的深度和宽度进行可扩展训练。
AI.result: HeavySkill一致优于传统Best-of-N策略；强LLM可接近Pass@N性能；思考的深度和宽度可通过强化学习进一步扩展。
AI.conclusion: 深度思考作为一种可学习的、可扩展的内化技能，为LLM走向自我进化提供了有前景的路径，无需依赖脆弱的外部编排层。

title: Video Active Perception: Effective Inference-Time Long-Form Video Understanding with Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced multimodal tasks such as video question answering (QA). However, VLMs face the challenge of selecting frames effectively and efficiently, as standard uniform sampling is expensive and performance may plateau. Inspired by active perception theory, which posits that models gain information by acquiring data that differs from their expectations, we introduce Video Active Perception (VAP), a training-free method to enhance long-form video QA using VLMs. Our approach treats keyframe selection as data acquisition in active perception and leverages a lightweight text-conditioned video generation model to represent prior world knowledge. Empirically, VAP achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot results on long-form or reasoning video QA datasets such as EgoSchema, NExT-QA, ActivityNet-QA, IntentQA, and CLEVRER, achieving an increase of up to 5.6 x frame efficiency by frames per question over standard GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and LLaVA-OV. Moreover, VAP shows stronger reasoning abilities than previous methods and effectively selects keyframes relevant to questions. These findings highlight the potential of leveraging active perception to improve the frame effectiveness and efficiency of long-form video QA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Video Active Perception (VAP)方法，无需训练即可通过轻量级文本条件视频生成模型选择关键帧，在长视频问答任务中实现5.6倍帧效率提升和SOTA零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在处理长视频问答时面临帧选择效率低下的问题，均匀采样成本高且性能可能停滞，因此需要更有效和高效的帧选择方法。
AI.method: 受主动感知理论启发，将关键帧选择视为数据获取过程，利用轻量级文本条件视频生成模型作为先验世界知识，无需额外训练即可选择与问题相关的关键帧。
AI.result: 在EgoSchema、NExT-QA、ActivityNet-QA、IntentQA和CLEVRER等数据集上取得零样本SOTA结果，帧效率相比GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro和LLaVA-OV提升最多5.6倍。
AI.conclusion: VAP方法有效提升了长视频QA中帧的选择有效性和效率，展示了主动感知在改进视频理解任务中的潜力。

title: Revisiting Semantic Role Labeling: Efficient Structured Inference with Dependency-Informed Analysis
summary: Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) provides an explicit representation of predicate-argument structure, capturing linguistically grounded relations such as who did what to whom. While recent NLP progress has been dominated by large language models (LLMs), these systems often rely on implicit semantic representations, often lacking explicit structural constraints and systematic explanatory mechanisms. Traditionally, SRL systems have often relied on AllenNLP; however, the framework entered maintenance mode in December 2022, limiting compatibility with evolving encoder architectures and modern inference requirements. We revisit structured SRL modeling, introducing a modernized encoder-based framework that preserves explicit predicate-argument structure while enabling inference 10 times faster. Using BERT-base, the model attains comparable predictive performance, and RoBERTa and DeBERTa further improve F1 performance within the same framework. We adopt a dependency-informed diagnostic methodology to characterize span-level inconsistencies and conduct a representation-level analysis of LLM behavior under dependency-informed structural signals. Results indicate that dependency cues primarily improve structural stability. Finally, we illustrate how the framework's explicit predicate-argument structure can support multilingual SRL projection as a downstream application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种现代化的编码器框架，在保持显式谓词-论元结构的同时实现10倍推理加速，并利用BERT、RoBERTa和DeBERTa取得可比或更优的语义角色标注性能，同时通过依存诊断方法分析结构稳定性，展示其在多语言SRL投影中的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM缺乏显式结构约束和系统性解释机制，而传统SRL系统依赖已进入维护模式的AllenNLP，与新型编码器架构和现代推理需求不兼容。
AI.method: 提出现代化的编码器框架，保持显式谓词-论元结构；采用依存信息诊断方法分析span级别不一致性；进行LLM在依存结构信号下的表征级分析。
AI.result: 推理速度提升10倍；BERT-base取得可比性能，RoBERTa和DeBERTa进一步提升F1；依存线索主要提升结构稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架在保持结构可解释性的同时显著提升效率，并可有效支持多语言SRL投影等下游应用。

title: IMPACT-HOI: Supervisory Control for Onset-Anchored Partial HOI Event Construction
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/541741106/IMPACT_HOI
summary: We present IMPACT-HOI, a mixed-initiative framework for annotating egocentric procedural video by constructing structured event graphs for Human-Object Interactions (HOI), motivated by the need for high-quality structured supervision for learning robot manipulation from human demonstration. IMPACT-HOI frames this task as the incremental resolution of a partially specified, onset-anchored event state. A trust-calibrated controller selects among direct queries, human-confirmed suggestions, and conservative completions based on empirical annotator behavior and evidence quality. A risk-bounded execution protocol, utilizing atomic rollback, ensures that human-confirmed decisions are preserved against conflicting automated updates. A user study with 9 participants shows a 13.5% reduction in manual annotation actions, a 46.67% event match rate, and zero confirmed-field violations under the studied protocol. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/541741106/IMPACT_HOI.

AI.tldr: IMPACT-HOI提出了一种混合主动框架，通过构建结构化事件图来标注以自我为中心的程序性视频中的人-物交互，实现了13.5%的手动标注动作减少、46.67%的事件匹配率以及零确认字段违例。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示中学习机器人操作需要高质量的结构化监督信号，但现有标注方法效率低、易出错，亟需一种混合主动的交互式标注框架来平衡自动化效率与人类控制精度。
AI.method: 将HOI事件图构建视为部分指定、锚定起始事件状态的增量求解过程；设计信任校准控制器，根据标注者行为和证据质量在直接查询、人工确认建议和保守补全之间选择；采用原子回滚的风险受限执行协议，保护人工确认的决策不受冲突的自动更新影响。
AI.result: 9名参与者实验显示：手动标注动作减少13.5%，事件匹配率达46.67%，在所研究协议下实现零确认字段违例。
AI.conclusion: IMPACT-HOI有效降低了人工标注负担，同时保证了标注质量，为机器人学习从人类演示中提取结构化HOI信息提供了可行的混合主动解决方案。

title: FitText: Evolving Agent Tool Ecologies via Memetic Retrieval
summary: A semantic gap separates how users describe tasks from how tools are documented. As API ecosystems scale to tens of thousands of endpoints, static retrieval from the initial query alone cannot bridge this gap: the agent's understanding of what it needs evolves during execution, but its tool set does not. We introduce FitText, a training-free framework that makes retrieval dynamic by embedding it directly in the agent's reasoning loop. FitText generates natural-language pseudo-tool descriptions as retrieval probes, refines them iteratively using retrieval feedback, and explores diverse alternatives through stochastic generation. Memetic Retrieval adds evolutionary selection pressure over candidate descriptions, guided by a tool memory that avoids redundant search. On ToolRet (43k tools, 4 domains), FitText improves average retrieval rank from 8.81 to 2.78; on StableToolBench (16,464 APIs), it achieves a 0.73 average pass rate--a 24-point absolute gain over static query retrieval. The gains transfer across base models capable of acting as competent semantic operators; under weaker base models, Memetic's evolutionary search inverts--amplifying noise rather than refining signal--surfacing model capacity as a prerequisite for evolutionary tool exploration.

AI.tldr: FitText是一个无需训练的框架，通过将动态检索嵌入智能体推理循环，利用演化搜索和工具记忆，显著提升工具检索效果（ToolRet上平均排名从8.81降至2.78，StableToolBench上通过率提升24个百分点）。但该方法依赖强基座模型，弱模型下演化搜索反而会放大噪声。
AI.motivation: 现有工具检索系统存在语义鸿沟：用户查询是静态的，但智能体在任务执行过程中对工具的理解是动态演化的，静态检索无法满足这种需求。
AI.method: FitText框架将检索嵌入推理循环，先生成自然语言伪工具描述作为检索探针，再通过检索反馈迭代优化，并利用随机生成探索多样化候选。此外，引入Memetic检索，对候选描述施加演化选择压力，配合工具记忆避免冗余搜索。
AI.result: 在ToolRet（43k工具，4领域）上，平均检索排名从8.81提升至2.78；在StableToolBench（16,464 API）上，平均通过率达到0.73，相比静态查询检索绝对提升24个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动态检索嵌入推理循环能有效弥合语义鸿沟，但该方法依赖基座模型作为语义操作符的能力，弱模型下演化搜索会反转效果，即模型能力是演化工具探索的前提条件。

title: SemEval-2026 Task 7: Everyday Knowledge Across Diverse Languages and Cultures
comment: SemEval-2026 Task Description Paper. Data and resources are available at \url{https://github.com/BLEnD-SemEval2026/SemEval-2026-Task-7
summary: We present our shared task on evaluating the adaptability of LLMs and NLP systems across multiple languages and cultures. The task data consist of an extended version of our manually constructed BLEnD benchmark (Myung et al. 2024), covering more than 30 language-culture pairs, predominantly representing low-resource languages spoken across multiple continents. As the task is designed strictly for evaluation, participants were not permitted to use the data for training, fine-tuning, few-shot learning, or any other form of model modification. Our task includes two tracks: (a) Short-Answer Questions (SAQ) and (b) Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ). Participants were required to predict labels and were allowed to submit any NLP system and adopt diverse modelling strategies, provided that the benchmark was used solely for evaluation. The task attracted more than 140 registered participants, and we received final submissions from 62 teams, along with 19 system description papers. We report the results and present an analysis of the best-performing systems and the most commonly adopted approaches. Furthermore, we discuss shared insights into open questions and challenges related to evaluation, misalignment, and methodological perspectives on model behaviour in low-resource languages and for under-represented cultures.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BLEnD扩展基准上的共享任务，涵盖30+语言-文化对（主要为低资源语言），吸引140+注册、62个团队提交，报告了最佳系统和常用方法，并讨论了低资源语言与文化评估中的挑战与见解。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM和NLP系统在多语言、多文化环境下的适应性，特别关注低资源语言和未被充分代表的文化。
AI.method: 使用扩展版BLEnD基准（30+语言-文化对），设置短问答（SAQ）和多项选择（MCQ）两个赛道，仅用于评估，禁止训练/微调/少样本学习等模型修改。
AI.result: 140+注册，62个团队提交最终结果，19篇系统描述论文，报告了最佳系统表现和常用方法分析。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了低资源语言和文化评估中的开放问题与挑战，包括评估对齐、方法学视角以及模型行为偏差等。

title: The Model Knows, the Decoder Finds: Future Value Guided Particle Power Sampling
summary:
A recurring pattern in "reasoning without training" is that base LLMs already assign non-trivial probability mass to correct multi-step solutions; the bottleneck is locating these modes efficiently at inference time. Power sampling provides a principled way to bias decoding toward such modes by targeting p_theta(x)^alpha with alpha > 1, but practical approximations must account for future-dependent correction factors that determine which prefixes remain promising.
  We introduce Auxiliary Particle Power Sampling (APPS), a blockwise particle algorithm for approximating the sequence-level power target with a bounded population of partial solutions. APPS propagates hypotheses in parallel using proposal-corrected power reweighting and refines their survival through future-value-guided selection at resampling boundaries. This redistributes finite compute across competing prefixes rather than committing to a single unfolding path, while providing a direct scaling knob in the particle count and predictable peak memory. We instantiate the future-value signal with short-horizon rollouts and also study an amortized variant that replaces rollouts with a lightweight learned selection head. Across reasoning benchmarks, APPS improves the accuracy-runtime trade-off of training-free decoding and suggests that part of the gap to post-trained systems can be recovered through more faithful inference-time power approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出APPS（辅助粒子功率采样）方法，通过粒子滤波算法在推理时高效逼近功率分布目标，在无训练条件下提升大语言模型的多步推理能力，缩小与后训练系统的差距。
AI.motivation: 基础LLM在无训练条件下已对正确多步推理路径分配了非平凡的概率质量，但瓶颈在于推理时如何高效定位这些模式。现有功率采样方法需要未来依赖修正因子，而实际近似方案未能充分解决前缀选择问题。
AI.method: 提出APPS算法，采用分块粒子滤波框架：1) 通过提议校正功率重加权并行传播假设；2) 在重采样边界使用未来价值引导的选择机制；3) 引入短视展开或轻量学习选择头作为未来价值信号；4) 粒子数量提供直接的计算缩放旋钮。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，APPS显著提升了无训练解码的准确率-时间权衡曲线，表明更忠实的推理时功率近似可以弥合与后训练系统的部分性能差距。
AI.conclusion: APPS通过更精确的推理时功率分布近似，在无额外训练条件下有效提升LLM推理能力，验证了通过改进解码算法而非模型训练来缩小与有训练系统差距的可行性。

title: IMPACT-Scribe: Interactive Temporal Action Segmentation with Boundary Scribbles and Query Planning
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/BanzQians/IMPACT_AS
summary: Dense temporal annotation of procedural activity videos is vital for action understanding and embodied intelligence but remains labor-intensive due to reactive tools. Each correction is treated as an isolated edit, limiting reuse of information on annotator uncertainty and model reliability. We introduce IMPACT-Scribe, a correction-driven framework for dense labeling that uses each correction to improve future human-machine collaboration. IMPACT-Scribe combines uncertainty-aware boundary scribble supervision, local proposal modeling, cost-aware query planning, structured propagation, and correction-driven adaptation. Experiments and a human study show that this closed-loop design improves labeling quality per effort, enhances boundary accuracy, and fosters better human-machine interaction over time. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/BanzQians/IMPACT_AS.

AI.tldr: IMPACT-Scribe提出了一种基于修正的密集时间标注框架，通过利用每次人工修正来改进人机协作，实现对程序性活动视频的高效标注。
AI.motivation: 现有视频密集时间标注工具效率低下，每次修正都被视为孤立编辑，无法利用标注者不确定性和模型可靠性的信息，导致重复劳动。
AI.method: 提出IMPACT-Scribe框架，包含不确定性感知的边界涂鸦监督、局部提议建模、代价感知的查询规划、结构化传播以及基于修正的自适应学习等模块。
AI.result: 实验和人工研究表明，闭环设计在同等标注努力下提升了标注质量，边界精度更高，且人机交互随时间推移不断改善。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了利用每次修正来迭代改进人机协作的有效性，为密集视频标注提供了更高效、更智能的解决方案。

title: Dependency Parsing Across the Resource Spectrum: Evaluating Architectures on High and Low-Resource Languages
summary: Transformer-based models achieve state-of-the-art dependency parsing for high-resource languages, yet their advantage over simpler architectures in low-resource settings remains poorly understood. We evaluate four parsers -- the Biaffine LSTM, Stack-Pointer Network, AfroXLMR-large, and RemBERT -- across ten typologically diverse languages, with a focus on low-resource African languages. We find that the Biaffine LSTM consistently outperforms transformer models in low-resource regimes, with transformers recovering their advantage as training data increases. The crossover falls within a resource range typical of treebanks for under-resourced languages. Morphological complexity (measured via MATTR) emerges as a significant secondary predictor of transformers' relative disadvantage after controlling for corpus size. These results indicate that the Biaffine LSTM may be better suited for syntactic tool development in low-resource regimes until sufficient annotated data is available to leverage the representational capacity of pre-trained transformers.

AI.tldr: 在低资源场景下，Biaffine LSTM 在依存句法分析中持续优于 Transformer 模型；Transformer 的优势仅在训练数据充足时显现。
AI.motivation: Transformer 模型在高资源语言上表现优异，但在低资源环境下是否仍具优势尚不明确，尤其是对非洲低资源语言缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 在10种类型多样的语言上对比四种句法分析器（Biaffine LSTM、Stack-Pointer Network、AfroXLMR-large、RemBERT），重点关注低资源非洲语言，并引入形态复杂度（MATTR）作为预测变量。
AI.result: Biaffine LSTM 在低资源情况下始终优于 Transformer 模型；Transformer 的优势随数据量增加而恢复，两者交叉点恰好落在低资源语言树库的数据范围内；形态复杂度是除语料规模外的显著次要预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源场景下，Biaffine LSTM 更适合句法工具开发；建议在积累足够标注数据前优先使用该架构，之后再利用预训练 Transformer 的表示能力。

title: Measuring AI Reasoning: A Guide for Researchers
summary: In this paper, we offer a guide for researchers on evaluating reasoning in language models, building the case that reasoning should be assessed through evidence of adaptive, multi-step search rather than final-answer accuracy alone. Under an evaluation-oriented definition, reasoning requires selecting intermediate steps and halting according to input-dependent conditions, which we formalize as a search-like procedure. We show that single forward passes in scalable architectures are structurally limited in their ability to realize such variable-depth computation, motivating intermediate decoding and externalized reasoning traces as appropriate evaluation interfaces. Central to our argument is that final-answer accuracy alone is an insufficient measure of reasoning, because it provides little ability to diagnose or debug the underlying processes that produce individual solutions in frontier models. We therefore argue for a shift toward process-based evaluation, in which reasoning is assessed through the faithfulness and validity of intermediate reasoning traces as first-class evaluation targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估语言模型推理能力应关注适应性、多步搜索过程而非仅看最终答案准确性，并倡导基于中间推理轨迹的过程化评估。
AI.motivation: 现有评估过度依赖最终答案准确性，无法诊断或调试模型在生成解决方案时的底层推理过程，缺乏对推理机制的深入理解。
AI.method: 从评估导向定义推理（需根据输入条件选择中间步骤并适时终止），形式化为类搜索过程；分析单次前向传播在可扩展架构中的结构限制，提出中间解码和外化推理轨迹作为评估接口。
AI.result: 单次前向传播难以实现可变深度的推理计算；最终答案准确性不足以衡量推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 应转向过程化评估，将中间推理轨迹的忠实性和有效性作为首要评估目标。

title: TrajRAG: Retrieving Geometric-Semantic Experience for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
summary: Existing zero-shot Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) methods often exploit commonsense knowledge from large language or vision-language models to guide navigation. However, such knowledge arises from internet-scale text rather than embodied 3D experience, and episodic observations collected during navigation are typically discarded, preventing the accumulation of lifelong experience. To this end, we propose Trajectory RAG (TrajRAG), a retrieval-augmented generation framework that enhances large-model reasoning by retrieving geometric-semantic experiences. TrajRAG incrementally accumulates episodic observations from past navigation episodes. To structure these observations, we propose a topological-polar (topo-polar) trajectory representation that compactly encodes spatial layouts and semantic contexts, effectively removing redundancies in raw episodic observations. A hierarchical chunking structure further organizes similar topo-polar trajectories into unified summaries, enabling coarse-to-fine retrieval. During navigation, candidate frontiers generate multiple trajectory hypotheses that query TrajRAG for similar past trajectories, guiding large-model reasoning for waypoint selection. New experiences are continually consolidated into TrajRAG, enabling the accumulation of lifelong navigation experience. Experiments on MP3D, HM3D-v1, and HM3D-v2 show that TrajRAG effectively retrieves relevant geometric-semantic experiences and improves zero-shot ObjectNav performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrajRAG，一种通过检索增强生成框架来积累和利用过去导航轨迹经验，以提升零样本物体目标导航性能的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本ObjectNav方法依赖互联网文本知识而非具身3D经验，且导航中的 episodic 观测被丢弃，无法积累终身经验。
AI.method: 提出拓扑-极坐标轨迹表示压缩空间布局和语义上下文；设计层级分块结构组织相似轨迹为统一摘要；导航时通过候选前沿生成轨迹假设，查询TrajRAG检索相似历史轨迹以引导大模型选择路径点。
AI.result: 在MP3D、HM3D-v1和HM3D-v2数据集上，TrajRAG有效检索相关几何-语义经验，显著提升零样本ObjectNav性能。
AI.conclusion: TrajRAG通过检索和积累具身导航经验，弥补了纯文本知识的不足，实现了终身导航经验的持续积累。

title: Beating the Style Detector: Three Hours of Agentic Research on the AI-Text Arms Race
summary: Reproducing an empirical NLP study used to take weeks. Given the released data and a modern agentic-research harness, we redo every experiment of a recent ACL\,2026 study on personal-style post-editing of LLM drafts -- and add three new ones -- with the human investigator acting only as a reviewer-in-the-loop. We reproduce all seven preregistered hypotheses and recover the paper's headline correlation between perceived self-similarity and embedding-measured self-similarity to three decimal places ($r{=}{+}0.244$, $p{<}10^{-8}$, $n{=}648$). Under a leakage-free held-out protocol, GPT-5.5 and Claude\,Opus\,4.7 close $71$--$75\,\%$ of the style gap to the same-author ceiling on $324$ paired tasks, against $24\,\%$ for the human post-edit, and beat the human post-edit on $\sim$$80\,\%$ of tasks. We then frame the same data as an AI-text detection arms race. A leave-authors-out linear SVM on LUAR-MUD embeddings reaches AUC $0.93$--$1.00$ across approaches; six diagnostics show that GPT-5.5 detection is mostly a length confound while Opus detection is a genuine stylistic signature. Given $T{=}20$ feedback iterations against the frozen detector, an Opus agent flips two of five held-out test mimics to the human half-space and shrinks every margin by an order of magnitude. With moderate effort against a known detector, a frontier LLM can already efficiently lower its own AI-detection probability. All code, $648$ mimic drafts, trained detectors, diagnostics, and adversarial trajectories are released.

AI.tldr: 本文利用自动化研究框架在三天内复现了ACL'2026关于个人风格编辑LLM草稿的完整实验，并新增三项实验。结果显示GPT-5.5和Claude Opus 4.7分别能缩小71-75%的风格差距，远超人类编辑的24%，同时揭示了AI文本检测的对抗性演化。
AI.motivation: 传统NLP实验复现需要数周时间，效率极低。作者希望证明借助现代智能体研究框架和已发布数据，可以极大加速复现过程，同时探索前沿LLM的风格模仿能力及其对AI文本检测的对抗性影响。
AI.method: 使用智能体研究框架自动化重做ACL'2026的所有实验（7个预注册假设），人类仅作为"审阅者"；新增三项实验；采用无泄漏的留出协议；使用LUAR-MUD嵌入的线性SVM进行检测；对Opus智能体进行20轮反馈迭代以对抗检测器。
AI.result: 1) 成功复现所有假设，自相似性相关系数精确到小数点后三位（r=+0.244）；2) GPT-5.5和Claude Opus 4.7缩小71-75%风格差距，人类仅24%；3) 检测器AUC达0.93-1.00；4) GPT-5.5检测存在长度混淆，Opus检测为真实风格特征；5) 20轮对抗后Opus智能体可使部分模仿样本越过检测边界。
AI.conclusion: 前沿LLM已能高效降低自身被AI检测的概率，AI文本风格模仿与检测之间存在持续的"军备竞赛"；自动化复现框架可大幅提升NLP研究的可复现性和效率。

title: Synthetic Users, Real Differences: an Evaluation Framework for User Simulation in Multi-Turn Conversations
summary: There is growing interest in exploring user simulation as an alternative to gathering and scoring real user-chatbot interactions for AI chatbot evaluation. For this purpose, it is important to ensure the realism of the simulation, i.e., the extent to which simulated dialogues reflect real dialogues users have with chatbots. Most existing methods evaluating simulation realism produce coarse quality signal and remain solely at the level of individual dialogues. To support more rigorous evaluation in this area, we propose realsim, an evaluation framework that enables practitioners to take a distributional view of real vs. simulated dialogues along 8 dimensions, covering attributes related to the communicative functions of the interaction, user states, and the surface form of user messages. We then instantiate the framework with a curated dataset of 1K multi-turn task-focused real user-chatbot dialogues that cover 16 domains of chatbot applications. Overall, we find that simulated users tend to struggle at capturing communication frictions that real users introduce to interactions, which could make evaluations based on such simulations overly optimistic. We also observe variability in performance across different domains, which may indicate a need for domain-specific user simulators.

AI.tldr: 提出RealSim评估框架，从8个维度(交互功能、用户状态、用户消息表面形式)对比真实与模拟对话的分布差异，发现模拟用户难以捕捉真实用户的沟通摩擦，可能导致评估结果过于乐观，且不同领域表现存在差异。
AI.motivation: 现有用户模拟真实性评估方法粒度粗糙，仅停留在单轮对话层面，缺乏系统性的多维度评估框架。
AI.method: 提出RealSim框架，从8个维度(涉及交互功能、用户状态、用户消息表面形式)进行分布级对比；构建包含1K多轮任务型真实对话数据集(覆盖16个领域)。
AI.result: 模拟用户难以捕捉真实用户引入的沟通摩擦，这可能导致基于模拟的评估结果过于乐观；不同领域间模拟性能存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 需要更细粒度的分布级评估来指导用户模拟的改进，特定领域可能需要专门的用户模拟器。

title: Shadow-Loom: Causal Reasoning over Graphical World Model of Narratives
summary: Stories hold a reader's attention because they have causes, secrets, and consequences. Shadow-Loom is an experimental open-source framework that turns a narrative into a versioned graphical world model and lets two engines act on it: a causal physics grounded in Pearl's ladder of causation and a recently proposed counterfactual calculus over Ancestral Multi-World Networks; and a narrative physics that scores the same graph against four structural reader-states -- mystery, dramatic irony, suspense, and surprise -- in the tradition of Sternberg's curiosity/suspense/surprise triad, with suspense formalised in the structural-affect line of work on story comprehension and computational suspense. Large language models are used only at the boundary: extraction, rendering, and audit; identification, intervention, and counterfactual reasoning are carried out in typed code over the graph. The system is offered as a research artefact rather than as a benchmarked NLP model; code, fixtures, and pipeline are released open source.

AI.tldr: Shadow-Loom是一个将叙事转化为带版本控制的图形世界模型的开源框架，结合因果推理（基于Pearl的因果阶梯和反事实演算）与叙事物理（基于Sternberg的好奇/悬念/惊喜三元素及结构-情感理论），用大语言模型处理边界任务（提取、渲染、审计），核心因果与叙事推理由类型化代码在图上执行。
AI.motivation: 现有叙事分析系统要么只做因果推理忽略叙事结构，要么仅对故事文本做情感分析而缺乏因果模型支持。作者试图将因果推理（反事实推理）与叙事理论（悬念、戏剧反讽、惊喜等读者状态）统一到一个可计算的图形模型中。
AI.method: 构建一个带版本控制的图形世界模型（Ancestral Multi-World Networks），在其上运行两种引擎：1）因果物理引擎——基于Pearl的因果阶梯和反事实演算；2）叙事物理引擎——基于Sternberg的curiosity/suspense/surprise三元组以及结构-情感理论，计算四个读者状态（神秘、戏剧反讽、悬念、惊喜）。LLM仅用于边界任务（提取叙事、渲染可视化、审计验证），核心因果和叙事推理由类型化代码直接在图上执行。
AI.result: 论文以研究制品形式发布，开源了代码、测试数据和完整管线，未作为基准NLP模型进行评测。
AI.conclusion: Shadow-Loom展示了将因果推理与叙事理论结合的技术可行性，为叙事计算提供了一个可扩展、可审计的开源框架，因果与叙事两种物理引擎的交互值得进一步探索。

title: Linear-Time Global Visual Modeling without Explicit Attention
summary: Existing research largely attributes the global sequence modeling capability of Transformers to the explicit computation of attention weights, a process that inherently incurs quadratic computational complexity. In this work, we offer a novel perspective: we demonstrate that attention can be mathematically reframed as a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) equipped with dynamically predicted parameters. Through this lens, we explain attention's global modeling power not as explicit token-wise aggregation, but as an implicit process where dynamically generated parameters act as a compressed representation of the global context. Inspired by this insight, we investigate a fundamental question: can we achieve Transformer-level sequence global modeling entirely through dynamic parameterization while maintaining linear complexity, effectively replacing explicit attention? To explore this, we design various dynamic parameter prediction strategies and integrate them into standard network layers. Extensive empirical studies on vision models demonstrate that dynamic parameterization can indeed serve as a highly effective, linear-complexity alternative to explicit attention, opening new pathways for efficient sequence modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/WeightFormer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出注意力机制可被重新理解为一种动态参数预测的多层感知机（MLP），并基于此洞察设计了线性复杂度的动态参数化方法，作为显式注意力的高效替代方案，在视觉模型上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer的全局序列建模能力归因于显式的注意力权重计算，但该方法具有二次计算复杂度。作者希望探索能否通过动态参数化实现线性复杂度的全局建模，从而替代显式注意力机制。
AI.method: 将注意力重新框架为具有动态预测参数的MLP，设计多种动态参数预测策略并将其集成到标准网络层中，实现线性复杂度的序列全局建模。
AI.result: 在视觉模型上的大量实验表明，动态参数化可以作为显式注意力的高效替代方案，具备线性复杂度且性能优异。
AI.conclusion: 动态参数化是一种有效的线性复杂度全局序列建模方法，为高效序列建模开辟了新路径。

title: Mapping Discourse Reframing: A Multi-Layer Network Approach to Italian HPV Vaccine Discourse on X (2010-2024)
summary: Understanding how online narratives travel through coalitions is critical for identifying information disorder, yet computational analyses often rely on conservative network constructions that erase initially sparse but salient signals. This paper proposes a novel multi-layer framework that captures low-frequency signals of emerging information disorder allowing for locating where online discourse is reframed and amplified over time. The use case is 14 years of Italian discourse on X regarding the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine across three pivotal epochs (2010-2024). Utilizing hashtag co-occurrence networks, we introduce a dual-layer approach. We first identify robust core discourse coalitions through conservative community detection, revealing a stable prevention-oriented backbone contrasted with increasingly separable skepticism coalitions. We then introduce a coverage layer and project fringe hashtags into core coalitions based on weighted connectivity. Using a manually labelled set of skeptical and conspiratorial seed tweets, we demonstrate that this core-coverage projection significantly improves the recovery of long-tail, problematic hashtags while preserving an interpretable coalition structure. Our findings characterize the structural maturation of polarized narratives and provide a methodology for mapping how discourse is reframed and amplified by information disorder over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双层网络框架，通过核心-覆盖投影方法捕捉低频信号，识别信息失调如何随时间在在线话语中被重构和放大。以意大利HPV疫苗14年X平台数据为例，验证了该方法能有效恢复长尾问题标签，揭示预防导向与怀疑论联盟的结构性分化。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法依赖保守的网络构建，容易忽略初始稀疏但重要的信号，导致无法准确捕捉新兴信息失调的传播路径。
AI.method: 提出双层框架：1）核心层通过保守社区检测识别稳定的话语联盟；2）覆盖层将边缘标签基于加权连接投影到核心联盟中，从而恢复低频但重要的信息失调信号。
AI.result: 核心-覆盖投影显著提升了长尾问题标签的恢复能力，同时保持了可解释的联盟结构。发现了预防导向联盟的稳定性与怀疑论联盟的日益分化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效刻画了极化叙事的结构性成熟过程，为映射信息失调如何随时间重构和放大话语提供了可行方法论。

title: Efficient Temporal Datalog Materialisation for Composite Event Recognition
summary: Several applications demand the timely detection of critical situations, such as threats to safety and transparency, over high-velocity streams of symbolic events. This demand has motivated the development of (i) event specification languages, which define composite events via temporal patterns over simpler events, and (ii) stream reasoning frameworks, evaluating patterns expressed in these languages. However, event specification languages are typically studied in isolation, complicating their comparison in terms of expressivity and obscuring the scope of their associated stream reasoners. To mitigate this issue, we map practical fragments of prominent event specification languages into Temporal Datalog->-, a temporal Datalog with stratified negation and no future dependencies. To support efficient stream reasoning over Temporal Datalog->-, we propose Streaming Trigger Graphs, an extension of a state-of-the-art technique for Datalog materialisation. Our approach yields a uniform composite event recognition mechanism that has the potential to generalise across a wide range of practical event specification languages.
