We use guidance composition to close the domain gap between stylistically finetuned and foundation models, preserving the original image semantics while applying stylistic adjustments. To ensure consistent edits, we introduce a training regularization loss and enhance DDIM inversion with optimized null-conditional embeddings for real image editing. We validate our approach by learning from stylistically filtered synthetic datasets varying a range of stylistic attributes, including outlines, local contrast, watercolorization effects, and geometric patterns. Our evaluations demonstrate that compared to current text-based editing techniques, our method offers well-integrated, more precise and continuously adjustable stylistic modifications.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过学习解耦编辑方向来实现扩散模型风格精细参数化控制的方法，使用引导组合和正则化损失保持语义一致性，支持连续可调的风格编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在风格属性控制上缺乏精确性，容易导致非预期的内容修改，需要更精细的参数化风格控制方法。
AI.method: 从合成数据集中学习解耦的编辑方向；使用引导组合缩小风格微调模型与基础模型之间的领域差距；引入训练正则化损失；通过优化空条件嵌入增强DDIM反转用于真实图像编辑。
AI.result: 在轮廓、局部对比度、水彩化效果和几何图案等多种风格属性上验证了有效性，相比现有文本编辑技术，实现了更精确、连续可调且更自然的风格修改。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在风格编辑的精确性和可控性上优于当前基于文本的编辑技术，能够实现风格属性的连续可调控制而不破坏原始语义。

title: StableMind: Source-Free Cross-Subject fMRI Decoding with Regularized Adaptation
summary: Existing cross-subject fMRI decoding methods typically train a model on multiple scanned subjects and then adapt it to a new subject using substantial paired fMRI-image data. However, in realistic scenarios, new-subject fMRI data are often limited due to costly data acquisition, and raw data from previous subjects may be inaccessible, leading existing methods to suffer performance degradation during new-subject adaptation. In this paper, we identify that this degradation stems from two key issues: brain-side instability caused by large subject differences in fMRI responses, and image-side supervision unreliability caused by fine-grained visual details that are not reliably supported by limited fMRI signals. To address these challenges, we propose StableMind, a regularized adaptation framework designed to improve brain-side representation stability and image-side supervision reliability. (1) To stabilize brain representations, StableMind reuses ridge projections from the pretrained model as adaptation priors to constrain limited-data new-subject adaptation, and applies Fourier-based feature-level brain augmentation to improve robustness to individual variability. (2) To improve image supervision reliability, StableMind introduces difficulty-aware image blur for brain-image alignment, reducing the influence of fine-grained visual details that are weakly supported by limited fMRI signals while preserving stable visual structure. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset under a unified 1-hour adaptation protocol demonstrate that StableMind achieves 84.02% image retrieval accuracy and 81.66% brain retrieval accuracy averaged over four subjects, surpassing the state-of-the-art method by 5.71% brain retrieval accuracy with fewer trainable adaptation parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/lingeringlight/StableMind.

AI.tldr: StableMind提出了一种正则化自适应框架，通过脑侧表示稳定（利用岭投影先验和傅里叶增强）和图像侧监督可靠（难度感知模糊对齐），在仅1小时fMRI数据下实现了跨被试解码的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨被试fMRI解码方法在新被试数据有限且过往被试原始数据不可访问时性能严重下降，该问题源于脑侧响应差异大导致的表示不稳定，以及图像侧细粒度视觉细节在有限fMRI信号下不可靠的双重挑战。
AI.method: (1) 脑侧稳定：使用预训练模型的岭投影作为适配先验约束新被试适配，并采用基于傅里叶的特征级脑增强提升个体变异性鲁棒性。(2) 图像侧可靠：引入难度感知的图像模糊策略，在脑-图对齐中降低由有限fMRI信号弱支持的细粒度细节影响，保留稳定视觉结构。
AI.result: 在Natural Scenes Dataset的1小时统一适配协议下，四个被试平均图像检索准确率84.02%，脑检索准确率81.66%，以更少可训练参数超越SOTA方法5.71%的脑检索准确率。
AI.conclusion: StableMind通过双侧重正则化策略有效解决了有限数据下跨被试fMRI解码的稳定性与可靠性问题，代码已开源。

title: Rethinking the Need for Source Models: Source-Free Domain Adaptation from Scratch Guided by a Vision-Language Model
summary: Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) adapts source models to target domains without accessing source data, addressing privacy and transmission issues. However, existing methods still initialize from a source pre-trained model and thus are not truly source-free. Recent works have introduced Vision-Language (ViL) models to guide the adaptation process, in these methods, we observe that for the same target domain, different source models yield minimal variation in final results, indicating the source model itself has limited impact. Motivated by this, we propose ViL-Only Domain Adaptation (VODA) , a stricter setting that eliminates all dependencies on source domain, relying solely on a randomly initialized model, a ViL model, and unlabeled target data. We analyze the adaptation dynamics of VODA and introduce Two-Stage Denoised-Region Distillation (TS-DRD) , a two-stage framework that first warms up the model with ViL guidance, then seek a Denoised-Region inherent in both the ViL and adapting model, yielding cleaner supervision for distillation. Experiments on Office-Home, VisDA, and DomainNet-126 show that under VODA, TS-DRD achieves competitive or superior performance to existing SFDA methods that still use source models, demonstrating its effectiveness and the potential of the VODA setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VODA（纯视觉-语言模型域适应）设定，完全消除对源模型的依赖，仅使用随机初始化模型、ViL模型和无标签目标数据，并设计了TS-DRD两阶段框架，在多个基准上取得了与甚至超越传统SFDA方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有SFDA方法虽声称无源数据，但仍需源预训练模型初始化，并非真正无源；且观察到不同源模型对最终结果影响甚微，因此提出完全消除源依赖的VODA设定。
AI.method: 提出Two-Stage Denoised-Region Distillation (TS-DRD)两阶段框架：第一阶段利用ViL模型引导对随机初始化模型进行预热；第二阶段寻找ViL与自适应模型共有的去噪区域，生成更干净的蒸馏监督信号。
AI.result: 在Office-Home、VisDA和DomainNet-126三个基准上，TS-DRD在VODA设定下取得了与甚至优于传统SFDA方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: VODA设定和TS-DRD方法证明了在完全无源域依赖的情况下实现有效域适应的可行性，挑战了源模型在域适应中不可或缺的传统认知。

title: Retrieving Any Relevant Moments: Benchmark and Models for Generalized Moment Retrieval
comment: Code and dataset: https://github.com/dymm9977/generalized-moment-retrieval. Keywords: video moment retrieval, temporal grounding, benchmark, multi-modal learning
summary: Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) aims to localize temporal segments in videos that correspond to a natural language query, but typically assumes only a single matching moment for each query. This assumption does not always hold in real-world scenarios, where queries may correspond to multiple or no moments. Thus, we formulate Generalized Moment Retrieval (GMR), a unified setting that requires retrieving the complete set of relevant moments or predicting an empty set. To enable systematic study of GMR, we introduce Soccer-GMR, a large-scale benchmark built on challenging soccer videos that reflect general GMR scenarios, with realistic negative and positive queries. The benchmark is constructed via a duration-flexible semi-automated pipeline with human verification, enabling scalable data generation while maintaining high annotation quality. We further design a unified evaluation protocol with complementary metrics tailored for null-set rejection, positive-query localization, and end-to-end GMR performance. Finally, we establish strong baselines across two modeling paradigms: a lightweight plug-and-play GMR adapter for discriminative VMR models, and a GMR-tailored GRPO reward for fine-tuning multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Extensive experiments show consistent gains across all metrics and expose key limitations of current methods, positioning GMR as a more realistic and challenging benchmark for video-language understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出广义视频时刻检索（GMR）任务，引入Soccer-GMR大规模基准数据集，并设计统一评估协议与两大基线方法，实验表明当前方法存在关键局限。
AI.motivation: 传统VMR假设每个查询仅对应一个匹配时刻，但真实场景中查询可能对应多个时刻或没有匹配时刻，因此需要更通用的GMR设定来覆盖这些情况。
AI.method: 构建Soccer-GMR基准数据集（基于足球视频，含负样本与正样本查询）；设计统一评估协议（包含空集拒绝、正查询定位、端到端指标）；提出两类基线（轻量级GMR适配器用于判别模型，以及GMR定制的GRPO奖励用于微调多模态大语言模型）。
AI.result: 在Soccer-GMR上实验表明，所提方法在所有指标上均有一致提升，同时揭示了当前方法的局限性。
AI.conclusion: GMR比传统VMR更贴近真实场景、更具挑战性，为视频语言理解提供了更现实的基准。

title: Rethinking Low-Light Image Enhancement: A Log-Domain Intensity--Chromaticity Decoupling Perspective
summary: Explicit reconstruction constraints derived from the decoupled representation are further imposed to suppress abnormal channel amplification and chromatic noise. Experiments on LOLv2-Real, MIT-Adobe FiveK, and LSRW show that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior quantitative and visual performance, reaching 29.71 dB PSNR and 0.89 SSIM on LOLv2-Real. DarkFace experiments further indicate improved downstream face detection under low-light conditions. Code and pretrained models are available at: https://github.com/mubaisam/ICD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于解耦表示的显式重建约束方法，用于抑制低光照图像增强中的异常通道放大和色度噪声，在多个数据集上取得了竞争性或更优的性能（LOLv2-Real上PSNR达29.71 dB，SSIM达0.89），并能改善暗光条件下的人脸检测效果。
AI.motivation: 低光照图像增强中存在异常通道放大和色度噪声问题，现有方法重建约束不足，需要提出更有效的显式约束来提升增强质量。
AI.method: 基于解耦表示推导显式重建约束，抑制异常通道放大和色度噪声。
AI.result: 在LOLv2-Real上达到29.71 dB PSNR和0.89 SSIM，在MIT-Adobe FiveK和LSRW上表现竞争或更优；DarkFace实验表明能改善低光条件下的人脸检测。
AI.conclusion: 提出的显式重建约束方法能有效提升低光照图像增强质量，并在下游任务（如人脸检测）中展现应用价值。

title: AutoFocus: Uncertainty-Aware Active Visual Search for GUI Grounding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled autonomous GUI agents that translate natural language instructions into executable screen coordinates. However, grounding performance degrades in high-resolution interfaces, where dense layouts and small interactive elements expose a resolution gap between modern displays and model input constraints. Existing zoom-in strategies rely on fixed anchors, heuristic grids, or reinforcement learning, lacking a principled mechanism to adaptively determine where refinement is needed and how much spatial uncertainty should be explored. We propose AutoFocus, a training-free, uncertainty-aware active visual search framework for GUI grounding. Our key insight is that token-level perplexity in coordinate generation naturally reflects spatial uncertainty. Rather than committing to a single prediction, AutoFocus samples multiple coordinate hypotheses and converts their axial perplexities into an anisotropic gaussian spatial probability field, explicitly modeling directional uncertainty. Based on this field, we generate global and local region proposals and introduce Shape-Aware Zooming to balance tight localization with contextual preservation. A visual prompt-based aggregation step then selects the most consistent prediction via structured comparison. Extensive experiments on ScreenSpot-Pro and ScreenSpot-V2 demonstrate consistent improvements across both general-purpose and GUI-specialized VLMs.

AI.tldr: AutoFocus是一种无需训练、基于不确定性感知的主动视觉搜索框架，通过token级困惑度构建各向异性高斯空间概率场，结合Shape-Aware Zooming和视觉提示聚合，有效提升了高分辨率界面中GUI grounding的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs在应对高分辨率界面时，密集布局和小交互元素导致定位性能下降；而现有的缩放策略（如固定锚点、启发式网格、强化学习）缺乏自适应确定需精化区域及探索空间不确定性的原理性机制。
AI.method: 1) 从坐标生成的token级困惑度构建各向异性高斯空间概率场，建模方向不确定性；2) 基于该场生成全局和局部区域提案；3) 引入Shape-Aware Zooming平衡精确定位与上下文保留；4) 通过视觉提示聚合从多个坐标假设中选择最一致的预测。
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro和ScreenSpot-V2基准测试上，AutoFocus在通用型与GUI专用型VLMs上均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: AutoFocus通过不确定性感知机制有效弥合了现代高分辨率显示与模型输入约束之间的分辨率差距，为GUI grounding提供了一种无需训练的自适应精细化方案。

title: ViewSAM: Learning View-aware Cross-modal Semantics for Weakly Supervised Cross-view Referring Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Cross-view Referring Multi-Object Tracking (CRMOT) aims to track multiple objects specified by natural language across multiple camera views, with globally consistent identities. Despite recent progress, existing methods rely heavily on costly frame-level spatial annotations and cross-view identity supervision. To reduce such reliance, we explore CRMOT under weak supervision by leveraging the capabilities of foundation models. However, our empirical study shows that directly applying foundation models such as SAM2 and SAM3, even with task-specific modifications, fails to accurately understand referring expressions and maintain consistent identities across views. Yet, they remain effective at producing reliable object tracklets that can serve as pseudo supervision. We therefore repurpose foundation models as pseudo-label generators and propose a two-stage framework for weakly supervised CRMOT, using only object category labels as coarse-grained supervision. In the first stage, we design an Affinity-guided Cross-view Re-prompting strategy to refine and associate SAM3-generated tracklets across cameras, producing reliable cross-view pseudo labels for subsequent training. In the second stage, we introduce ViewSAM, a CRMOT model built upon SAM2 that explicitly models view-aware cross-modal semantics. By formulating view-induced variations as learnable conditions, ViewSAM bridges the gap between view-variant visual observations and view-invariant textual expressions, enabling robust cross-view referring tracking with only approximately 10% additional parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ViewSAM achieves SOTA performance under weak supervision and remains competitive with fully supervised methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出弱监督跨视角指代多目标跟踪（CRMOT）框架，利用SAM2和SAM3作为伪标签生成器，仅需类别标签即可训练，提出的ViewSAM模型通过视角感知跨模态语义实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CRMOT方法严重依赖昂贵的帧级空间标注和跨视角身份监督，为降低这种依赖，探索在弱监督下利用基础模型的能力。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）亲和力引导的跨视角重提示策略，精炼和关联SAM3生成的tracklets；2）ViewSAM模型，基于SAM2构建，通过可学习条件建模视角引起的视觉变化，仅增加约10%参数。
AI.result: ViewSAM在弱监督下达到SOTA性能，并与全监督方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 成功将基础模型从直接应用转为伪标签生成器，实现弱监督CRMOT，显著降低标注成本。

title: Mamoda2.5: Enhancing Unified Multimodal Model with DiT-MoE
summary: We present Mamoda2.5, a unified AR-Diffusion framework that seamlessly integrates multimodal understanding and generation within a single architecture. To efficiently enhance the model's generation capability, we equip the Diffusion Transformer backbone with a fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) design (128 experts, Top-8 routing), yielding a 25B-parameter model that activates only 3B parameters, significantly reducing training costs while scaling up the model capacity. Mamoda2.5 achieves top-tier generation performance on VBench 2.0 and sets a new record in video editing quality, surpassing evaluated open-source models and matching the performance of current top-tier proprietary models, including the Kling O1 on OpenVE-Bench. Furthermore, we introduce a joint few-step distillation and reinforcement learning framework that compresses the 30-step editing model into a 4-step model and greatly accelerates model inference. Compared to open-source baselines, Mamoda2.5 achieves up to $95.9\times$ faster video editing inference. In real-world applications, Mamoda2.5 has been successfully deployed for content moderation and creative restoration tasks in advertising scenarios, achieving a 98% success rate in internal advertising video editing scenario.

AI.tldr: Mamoda2.5是一个统一的AR-Diffusion框架，通过MoE设计（128专家，Top-8路由）实现25B参数但仅激活3B，在视频生成和编辑任务上达到顶级性能，并通过蒸馏和强化学习将30步编辑模型压缩至4步，实现高达95.9倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在多模态理解与生成方面缺乏统一架构，且生成能力与推理效率之间存在矛盾，需要一种既能提升生成质量又能降低训练和推理成本的方法。
AI.method: 1) 采用Diffusion Transformer骨干网络结合细粒度MoE（128专家，Top-8路由），总参数量25B但仅激活3B；2) 提出联合少步蒸馏与强化学习框架，将30步编辑模型压缩为4步。
AI.result: 在VBench 2.0上达到顶级生成性能；在OpenVE-Bench视频编辑质量上超越开源模型，匹敌Kling O1等顶级闭源模型；推理速度相比开源基线提升高达95.9倍；内部广告场景视频编辑成功率达98%。
AI.conclusion: Mamoda2.5通过MoE高效扩展模型容量，结合蒸馏和强化学习实现极速推理，为多模态统一框架的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Human Activity Recognition Method for Moderate Violence Detection
summary: Physical violence in public spaces is a significant public health concern, with minor incidents such as pushing often serving as precursors to more severe escalations. This research develops an automated system for the real-time detection of moderate physical violence, specifically pushing, in surveillance camera footage. The proposed solution integrates state-of-the-art computer vision models, utilizing YOLO11 and YOLO11-Pose for human detection and skeletal keypoint extraction. By calculating body inclination and joint angles between shoulders and hips, a Random Forest classifier was trained to distinguish between normal behavior and aggressive physical contact. The system's performance was evaluated through three progressive case studies representing increasing levels of difficulty. In controlled environments with frontal views, the model achieved a precision of 0.98. In the most challenging scenario, featuring high-altitude, steep-angle recordings from real-world surveillance infrastructure, the system maintained a precision of 0.72 despite significant perspective distortion and visual noise. These results demonstrate the feasibility of using skeletal analysis for early violence intervention in urban security contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一套基于YOLO11和骨骼关键点分析的自动系统，用于实时检测监控视频中的推搡行为。在理想条件下精度达0.98，即使在具有挑战性的真实监控场景下也能保持0.72的精度。
AI.motivation: 公共场所的身体暴力是重要的公共卫生问题，轻微的推搡行为常常是更严重暴力事件的先兆。因此需要开发自动化的实时检测系统，以便在暴力升级前进行早期干预。
AI.method: 集成YOLO11和YOLO11-Pose进行人体检测和骨骼关键点提取，计算身体倾斜角度以及肩膀与臀部之间的关节角度，使用随机森林分类器区分正常行为与攻击性身体接触。
AI.result: 在受控环境（正面视角）中精度达0.98；在最具挑战性的真实监控场景（高海拔、陡峭角度、透视畸变和视觉噪声）中精度维持在0.72。
AI.conclusion: 证明了利用骨骼分析进行早期暴力干预在城市安全场景中的可行性。

title: Perceptual Flow Network for Visually Grounded Reasoning
comment: 36 pages with 17 figures, Accepted at ICML 2026
summary: Despite the success of Large-Vision Language Models (LVLMs), general optimization objectives (e.g., standard MLE) fail to constrain visual trajectories, leading to language bias and hallucination. To mitigate this, current methods introduce geometric priors from visual experts as additional supervision. However, we observe that such supervision is typically suboptimal: it is biased toward geometric precision and offers limited reasoning utility. To bridge this gap, we propose Perceptual Flow Network (PFlowNet), which eschews rigid alignment with the expert priors and achieves interpretable yet more effective visual reasoning. Specifically, PFlowNet decouples perception from reasoning to establish a self-conditioned generation process. Based on this, it integrates multi-dimensional rewards with vicinal geometric shaping via variational reinforcement learning, thereby facilitating reasoning-oriented perceptual behaviors while preserving visual reliability. PFlowNet delivers a provable performance guarantee and competitive empirical results, particularly setting new SOTA records on V* Bench (90.6%) and MME-RealWorld-lite (67.0%).

AI.tldr: 提出Perceptual Flow Network (PFlowNet)，通过解耦感知与推理、结合变分强化学习与邻域几何塑造，在无严格几何先验约束下实现更有效的视觉推理，在V* Bench和MME-RealWorld-lite上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM存在语言偏差和幻觉问题，而引入视觉专家几何先验作为监督的方法会导致偏向几何精度、推理效用有限。
AI.method: PFlowNet解耦感知与推理建立自条件生成过程，并基于变分强化学习整合多维奖励与邻域几何塑造，促进面向推理的感知行为同时保持视觉可靠性。
AI.result: 在V* Bench达到90.6%，在MME-RealWorld-lite达到67.0%，均刷新SOTA记录。
AI.conclusion: PFlowNet在理论上可证明性能保证，经验上取得具有竞争力的结果，验证了绕过刚性几何先验实现更有效视觉推理的可行性。

title: SIAM: Head and Brain MRI Segmentation from Few High-Quality Templates via Synthetic Training
summary: Synthetic training has recently advanced brain MRI segmentation by enabling contrast-agnostic models trained entirely on generated data. However, most existing approaches rely on hundreds of automatically labeled templates, introducing systematic biases and limiting their flexibility to incorporate new anatomical structures. We present the Segment It All Model (SIAM), a 3D whole-head segmentation framework for 16 anatomical structures, trained using only six high-quality, manually annotated templates. SIAM extends domain randomization to both intensity and shape domains: synthetic image generation ensures contrast variability, while high-resolution spatial transformations model anatomical differences in cortical thickness and deep nuclei morphology. Unlike prior synthetic models, SIAM simultaneously segments brain as well as extra-cerebral tissues, including cerebrospinal fluid, vessels, dura mater, skull, and skin, enabling fully automated, preprocessing-free analysis. Evaluation across eight heterogeneous datasets (N=301), that include multiple contrasts (T1-weighted, T2-weighted, CT) and span a wide range of ages, demonstrates that SIAM matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods for brain structures, in addition to extending automated segmentation to non-brain structures. The model also exhibits superior consistency across contrasts and repeated acquisitions, together with improved sensitivity to subtle gray matter atrophy. We openly release the model and the label templates at https://github.com/romainVala/SIAM.

AI.tldr: SIAM是一个仅用6个高质量手工标注模板训练的3D全脑分割模型，通过域随机化处理强度和形状变化，能同时分割16种脑内及脑外结构，在8个异质数据集上达到或超越现有方法水平。
AI.motivation: 现有合成训练方法依赖数百个自动标注模板，引入系统偏差且难以灵活纳入新解剖结构，因此需要一种仅用少量高质量手工标注模板即可训练、同时分割脑内和脑外结构的通用模型。
AI.method: 扩展域随机化到强度和形状两个领域：合成图像生成确保对比度可变性，高分辨率空间变换建模皮质厚度和深部核团形态的解剖差异；仅用6个高质量手工标注模板训练，实现16种解剖结构（包括脑组织和颅外组织）的3D全脑分割。
AI.result: 在8个异质数据集（N=301，包含T1、T2和CT等多种对比度及广泛年龄范围）上评估，SIAM在脑结构分割上匹配或超越现有最优方法，并扩展至非脑结构的自动分割；在跨对比度和重复采集上表现出更优的一致性，对灰质萎缩具有更高敏感性。
AI.conclusion: SIAM证明了仅用少量高质量手工标注模板即可训练出高性能的全脑分割模型，且能同时处理脑组织和颅外组织，无需预处理，具备良好的泛化性和临床实用性；模型和模板已开源。

title: Does it Really Count? Assessing Semantic Grounding in Text-Guided Class-Agnostic Counting
summary: Open-world text-guided class-agnostic counting (CAC) has emerged as a flexible paradigm for counting arbitrary object classes by using natural language prompts. However, current evaluation protocols primarily focus on standard counting errors within single-category images, overlooking a fundamental requirement: the ability to correctly ground the textual prompt in the visual scene. In this paper, we show that several state-of-the-art CAC models often struggle to determine which object class should be counted based on the given prompt, revealing a misalignment between textual semantics and visual object representations. This limitation leads to spurious counting responses and reduced reliability in real-world scenarios. To systematically address these limitations, we propose a new evaluation framework focused on model robustness and trustworthiness. Our contribution is two-fold: (i) we introduce PrACo++ (Prompt-Aware Counting++), a novel test suite featuring two dedicated evaluation protocols -- the negative-label test and the distractor test -- paired with new specialized metrics; and (ii) we present the MUCCA (MUlti-Category Class-Agnostic counting) evaluation dataset, a new collection of real-world images featuring multiple annotated object categories per scene, unlike existing CAC benchmarks that typically include a single category per image. Our extensive experimental evaluation of 10 state-of-the-art methods shows that, despite strong performance under standard counting metrics, current models exhibit significant weaknesses in understanding and grounding object class descriptions. Finally, we provide a quantitative analysis of how semantic similarity between prompts influences these failures. Overall, our results underscore the need for more semantically grounded architectures and offer a reliable framework for future assessment in open-world text-guided CAC methods.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有开放世界文本引导的类无关计数（CAC）模型存在文本语义与视觉对象表征不对齐的问题，提出了PrACo++测试套件和MUCCA数据集，通过负标签测试和干扰物测试等新协议系统评估模型的鲁棒性和可信度，实验表明当前SOTA方法在语义理解上存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前CAC模型的评估仅关注单类别图像中的标准计数误差，忽略了模型能否根据文本提示正确定位应计数的目标类别这一基本能力，导致模型在实际场景中不可靠。
AI.method: 提出了两方面的贡献：(i) PrACo++测试套件，包含负标签测试和干扰物测试两类评估协议及配套新指标；(ii) MUCCA数据集，每张图像包含多个标注类别的真实场景图像集合。
AI.result: 对10种SOTA方法的实验表明，尽管在标准计数指标上表现良好，当前模型在理解和定位目标类别描述方面存在显著不足；论文还定量分析了提示词语义相似性对失败的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了构建更强语义对齐架构的必要性，并为未来开放世界文本引导CAC方法的评估提供了可靠框架。

title: TOC-SR: Task-Optimal Compact diffusion for Image Super Resolution
summary: Diffusion models have recently demonstrated strong performance for image restoration tasks, including super-resolution. However, their large model size and iterative sampling procedures make them computationally expensive for practical deployment. In this work, we present TOC-SR, a framework for building efficient one-step super-resolution models by first discovering a compact diffusion backbone. Starting from a sixteen-channel latent diffusion model, we construct parameter-efficient surrogate blocks using feature-wise generative distillation and perform architecture discovery using epsilon-constrained Bayesian Optimization to minimize model complexity while preserving generative fidelity. The resulting compact diffusion backbone achieves a 6.6x reduction in parameters and a 2.8x reduction in GMACs compared to the expanded diffusion model. We then adapt this backbone for super-resolution and distill the diffusion process into a single-step generator. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach enables efficient super-resolution while maintaining strong reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出TOC-SR框架，通过紧凑扩散骨干网络和单步蒸馏，实现高效超分辨率重建，参数减少6.6倍，计算量减少2.8倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在超分辨率任务中表现优异，但模型庞大且迭代采样导致计算成本高，难以实际部署。
AI.method: 从16通道潜扩散模型出发，利用特征级生成蒸馏构建参数高效的替代块，通过ε约束贝叶斯优化进行架构搜索，压缩扩散骨干网络，再将蒸馏过程转化为单步生成器。
AI.result: 与扩展扩散模型相比，参数减少6.6倍，GMACs减少2.8倍，同时保持较好的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够实现高效的单步超分辨率重建，在降低计算开销的同时维持良好的图像恢复质量。

title: Linearizing Vision Transformer with Test-Time Training
summary: While linear-complexity attention mechanisms offer a promising alternative to Softmax attention for overcoming the quadratic bottleneck, training such models from scratch remains prohibitively expensive. Inheriting weights from pretrained Transformers provides an appealing shortcut, yet the fundamental representational gap between Softmax and linear attention prevents effective weight transfer. In this work, we address this conversion challenge from two perspectives: architectural alignment and representational alignment. We identify Test-Time Training (TTT) as a linear-complexity architecture whose two-layer dynamic formulation is structurally aligned with Softmax attention, enabling direct inheritance of pretrained attention weights. To further align representational properties, including key shift-invariance and locality, we introduce key instance normalization and a lightweight locality enhancement module. We validate our approach by linearizing Stable Diffusion 3.5 and introduce SD3.5-T$^5$ (Transformer To Test Time Training). With only 1 hour of fine-tuning on 4$\times$H20 GPUs, SD3.5-T$^5$ achieves comparable text-to-image quality to the fine-tuned Softmax model, while accelerating inference by 1.32$\times$ and 1.47$\times$ at 1K and 2K resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将预训练Softmax注意力模型转换为线性复杂度的TTT架构，通过架构对齐（识别TTT与Softmax注意力的结构相似性）和表示对齐（引入关键实例归一化和局部性增强模块），仅需1小时微调即可实现SD3.5的线性化加速，在1K和2K分辨率下分别获得1.32倍和1.47倍推理加速，且图像质量相当。
AI.motivation: 线性复杂度注意力机制虽然能克服Softmax注意力的二次方瓶颈，但从头训练成本过高。继承预训练Transformer权重是一条捷径，但Softmax注意力与线性注意力之间存在根本性的表示差距，阻碍了有效的权重迁移。
AI.method: 1) 架构对齐：识别TTT（Test-Time Training）作为一个线性复杂度架构，其双层动态公式与Softmax注意力在结构上对齐，可直接继承预训练注意力权重。2) 表示对齐：引入关键实例归一化（key instance normalization）解决键移不变性问题，以及轻量级局部性增强模块弥补局部性缺失。
AI.result: 在SD3.5上验证，仅需4×H20 GPU上微调1小时，线性化后的SD3.5-T⁵在文本到图像质量上与微调后的Softmax模型相当，推理速度在1K分辨率下加速1.32倍，2K分辨率下加速1.47倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构和表示双重对齐，成功实现了从预训练Softmax注意力到线性复杂度TTT架构的高效转换，大幅降低了训练成本并获得了显著的推理加速。

title: HumanSplatHMR: Closing the Loop Between Human Mesh Recovery and Gaussian Splatting Avatar
summary: Accurately recovering human pose and appearance from video is an essential component of scene reconstruction, with applications to motion capture, motion prediction, virtual reality, and digital twinning. Despite significant interest in building realistic human avatars from video, this paper demonstrates that existing methods do not accurately recover the 3D geometry of humans. ViT-based approaches are not consistently reliable and can overfit to 2D views, while NeRF- and Gaussian Splatting-based avatars treat pose and appearance separately, limiting rendering generalization to new poses. To resolve these shortcomings, this paper proposes HumanSplatHMR, a joint optimization framework that refines 3D human poses while simultaneously learning a high-fidelity avatar for novel-view and novel-pose synthesis. Our key insight is to close the loop between geometric pose estimation and differentiable rendering. Unlike prior human avatar methods that rely on accurate human pose obtained through motion capture systems or offline refinement, which are impractical in in-the-wild scenarios, our approach uses only human mesh estimates from a state-of-the-art human pose estimator to better reflect real-world conditions. Therefore, instead of using the human pose only as a deformation prior, HumanSplatHMR backpropagates photometric, segmentation, and depth losses through a differentiable renderer to the pose parameters and global position. This coupling refines the global 3D pose over time, improving accuracy and alignment while producing better renderings from novel views. Experiments show consistent improvements over pose recovery baselines that omit image-level refinement and avatar baselines that decouple pose estimation from avatar reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HumanSplatHMR，一种联合优化框架，通过将几何姿态估计与可微渲染闭环结合，同时优化3D人体姿态和高保真人体化身，在无需动捕系统的条件下提升了姿态恢复精度和新视角/新姿态的渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在从视频中恢复人体三维几何方面不够准确：ViT方法可能过拟合2D视图，NeRF和3D高斯泼洒方法将姿态与外观分离，限制了新姿态的泛化能力。且现有化身方法依赖动捕系统或离线优化，不适用于真实场景。
AI.method: 提出HumanSplatHMR，构建姿态估计与可微渲染之间的闭环：仅使用SOTA人体姿态估计器得到的人体网格估计，通过可微渲染器反向传播光度损失、分割损失和深度损失到姿态参数和全局位置，实现姿态与化身的联合优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，HumanSplatHMR在姿态恢复和化身重建上均优于忽略图像级精度的姿态恢复基线和将姿态估计与化身重建解耦的化身基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过闭环优化，该方法能够在无动捕系统的条件下显著提升人体姿态恢复精度和新视角渲染质量，更适用于真实世界场景。

title: Edge-Efficient Image Restoration: Transformer Distillation into State-Space Models
summary: We propose a modular framework for hybrid image restoration that integrates transformer and state-space model (SSM) blocks with a focus on improving runtime efficiency on edge hardware. While transformers provide strong global modeling through self-attention, their attention kernels incur substantial latency on mobile devices, especially for high-resolution inputs. In contrast, SSMs such as Mamba offer lineartime sequence modeling with lower runtime overhead but may underperform on fine grained restoration tasks. To balance accuracy and efficiency, we train lightweight SSM blocks as feature-distilled surrogates of transformer blocks and use them to construct hybrid U-Net-style architectures. To automatically discover effective block combinations, we introduce Efficient Network Search (ENS), a multi-objective search strategy that selects task-specific hybrid configurations from pre-aligned components. ENS optimizes restoration quality while penalizing transformer usage, serving as a lightweight proxy for latency and enabling architecture discovery without repeated hardware profiling. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite CPU, the Restormer baseline requires 10119.52 ms for inference. In contrast, ENS-discovered hybrids significantly reduce runtime: ENS-Deblurring runs in 2973 ms (3.4x faster), ENS-Deraining in 5816 ms (1.74x faster), and ENS-Denoising in 8666 ms (1.17x faster), while maintaining competitive restoration quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合图像修复框架，结合Transformer和状态空间模型（SSM），并通过高效网络搜索（ENS）自动发现最佳模块组合，在移动端CPU上实现3.4倍加速，同时保持竞争性修复质量。
AI.motivation: Transformer在移动端高分辨率输入下推理延迟过高，而纯SSM模型在细粒度修复任务上表现不足，需要平衡精度与效率的混合架构。
AI.method: 训练轻量级SSM块作为Transformer块的特征蒸馏替代品，构建混合U-Net架构；引入多目标搜索策略ENS，在保证修复质量的同时惩罚Transformer使用量，无需重复硬件性能分析即可发现最优配置。
AI.result: 在骁龙8 Elite CPU上，ENS发现的混合架构相比Restormer基线：去模糊加速3.4倍（2973ms），去雨加速1.74倍（5816ms），去噪加速1.17倍（8666ms）。
AI.conclusion: ENS可自动发现任务适配的高效混合架构，在不显著牺牲修复质量的前提下大幅降低移动端推理延迟。

title: IConFace: Identity-Structure Asymmetric Conditioning for Unified Reference-Aware Face Restoration
summary: Blind face restoration is highly ill-posed under severe degradation, where identity-critical details may be missing from the degraded input. Same-identity references reduce this ambiguity, but mismatched pose, expression, illumination, age, makeup, or local facial states can lead to overuse of reference appearance. We propose \textbf{IConFace}, a unified reference-aware and no-reference framework with identity--structure asymmetric conditioning. References are distilled into a norm-weighted global AdaFace identity anchor for image-only modulation, while the degraded image is reinforced as the spatial structure anchor through low-rank residuals and block-wise degraded cross-attention with two-route memory. The resulting single checkpoint exploits references when available and falls back to no-reference restoration when absent, improving identity consistency, fine-detail recovery, and degraded-only restoration quality in a unified model.

AI.tldr: 提出IConFace统一框架，通过身份-结构非对称条件处理盲脸恢复，在有/无参考图像时均能提升恢复质量。
AI.motivation: 盲脸恢复在严重退化下高度病态，身份关键细节可能丢失。同身份参考可减少歧义，但姿态、表情等不匹配会导致参考外观过度使用。
AI.method: 提出IConFace框架，采用身份-结构非对称条件：参考图像通过归一化加权全局AdaFace身份锚点进行图像级调制；退化图像通过低秩残差和块级退化交叉注意力作为空间结构锚点。
AI.result: 单一检查点在有参考时利用参考，无参考时退化为无参考恢复，提升身份一致性、细节恢复和仅退化图像的恢复质量。
AI.conclusion: 统一模型能在有无参考两种场景下均取得更好效果，解决参考外观过度使用和退化恢复质量提升的问题。

title: VideoNet: A Large-Scale Dataset for Domain-Specific Action Recognition
summary: Videos are unique in their ability to capture actions which transcend multiple frames. Accordingly, for many years action recognition was the quintessential task for video understanding. Unfortunately, due to a lack of sufficiently diverse and challenging data, modern vision-language models (VLMs) are no longer evaluated on their action recognition capabilities. To revitalize action recognition in the era of VLMs, we advocate for a returned focus on domain-specific actions. To this end, we introduce VideoNet, a domain-specific action recognition benchmark covering 1,000 distinct actions from 37 domains. We begin with a multiple-choice evaluation setting, where the difference between closed and open models is stark: Gemini 3.1 Pro attains 69.9% accuracy while Qwen3-VL-8B gets a mere 45.0%. To understand why VLMs struggle on VideoNet, we relax the questions into a binary setting, where random chance is 50%. Still, Qwen achieves only 59.2% accuracy. Further relaxing the evaluation setup, we provide $k\in\{1,2,3\}$ in-context examples of the action. Some models excel in the few-shot setting, while others falter; Qwen improves $+7.0\%$, while Gemini declines $-4.8\%$. Notably, these gains fall short of the $+13.6\%$ improvement in non-expert humans when given few-shot examples. Finding that VLMs struggle to fully exploit in-context examples, we shift from test-time improvements to the training side. We collect the first large-scale training dataset for domain-specific actions, totaling nearly 500k video question-answer pairs. Fine-tuning a Molmo2-4B model on our data, we surpass all open-weight 8B models on the VideoNet benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VideoNet，一个包含37个领域、1000种动作的领域特定动作识别基准，发现当前视觉语言模型（VLM）在动作识别上表现不佳，即使提供上下文示例也难以媲美人类，并通过大规模训练数据集微调提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的视觉语言模型（VLM）缺乏对动作识别能力的评估，因为缺乏多样化且具有挑战性的数据。为了复兴VLM时代的动作识别研究，作者主张重新关注领域特定的动作识别。
AI.method: 1）构建VideoNet基准，包含37个领域、1000种不同动作；2）采用多项选择、二选一、少样本（k=1,2,3）等多种评估设置；3）收集了近50万个视频问答对的大规模训练数据集；4）在收集的数据上微调Molmo2-4B模型。
AI.result: Gemini 3.1 Pro在多项选择设置中准确率69.9%，而Qwen3-VL-8B仅45.0%；在二选一设置中Qwen仅59.2%（随机水平50%）；少样本设置中Qwen提升+7.0%，但不及人类的+13.6%；微调后的Molmo2-4B超越了所有开源8B模型。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在领域特定动作识别上表现欠佳，难以充分利用上下文示例；通过大规模领域特定训练数据微调可以有效提升模型性能，为未来VLM的动作识别研究提供了新的基准和数据资源。

title: Active Sampling for Ultra-Low-Bit-Rate Video Compression via Conditional Controlled Diffusion
summary: Diffusion models provide a powerful generative prior for perceptual reconstruction at ultra-low bitrates, but effective video compression requires controlling the generative process using highly compact conditioning signals. In this work, we present ActDiff-VC, a diffusion-based video compression framework for the ultra-low-bitrate regime. Our method partitions videos into variable-length segments, transmits keyframes only when needed, and summarizes temporal dynamics using a compact set of tracked point trajectories. Conditioned on these sparse signals, a conditional diffusion decoder synthesizes the remaining frames, enabling perceptually realistic reconstruction under severe rate constraints. To support this design, we introduce two mechanisms: content-adaptive keyframe selection and budget-aware sparse trajectory selection, which together enable compact yet effective conditioning for generative reconstruction. Experiments on the UVG and MCL-JCV benchmarks show that ActDiff-VC achieves up to 64.6\% bitrate reduction at matched NIQE, improves KID by up to 64.6\% and FID by up to 37.7\% at comparable bitrates against strong learned codecs, and delivers favorable perceptual rate--distortion trade-offs relative to learned and diffusion-based baselines in the ultra-low-bitrate regime.

AI.tldr: 提出ActDiff-VC，一种基于扩散模型的超低码率视频压缩框架，通过内容自适应关键帧选择和预算感知稀疏轨迹选择实现紧凑条件控制，在UVG和MCL-JCV基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在超低码率感知重建中表现出色，但现有方法缺乏有效的紧凑条件控制机制来指导视频生成过程，难以在极低码率下平衡码率与感知质量。
AI.method: 1) 将视频划分为可变长度分段，仅按需传输关键帧；2) 用紧凑的跟踪点轨迹总结时序动态；3) 引入内容自适应关键帧选择和预算感知稀疏轨迹选择两种机制；4) 条件扩散解码器基于稀疏信号合成剩余帧。
AI.result: 在UVG和MCL-JCV上，相比强学习编解码器：NIQE匹配下比特率降低64.6%，KID提升64.6%，FID提升37.7%，感知率失真权衡优于学习型和扩散型基线。
AI.conclusion: ActDiff-VC通过内容自适应关键帧和预算感知轨迹选择实现紧凑条件控制，在超低码率下实现了感知质量与码率的高效权衡，验证了扩散模型在极低比特率视频压缩中的潜力。

title: Pixel Perfect: Relational Image Quality Assessment with Spatially-Aware Distortions
summary: Traditional image quality assessment (IQA) methods rely on mean opinion scores (MOS), which are resource-intensive to collect and fail to provide interpretable, localized feedback on specific image distortions. We overcome these limitations by shifting from absolute quality prediction to a relational and directional assessment. Our approach utilizes a self-supervised synthetic distortion engine to generate training data, eliminating the need for manual annotation. A distortion prediction network is trained with an anti-symmetric objective to produce spatially-aware, disentangled maps that identify the type, intensity, and direction of distortions relative to a reference image. Subsequently, a scoring network is trained via contrastive learning on ordinally ranked image sets to predict a relational quality score. Our method provides a more granular and interpretable approach to IQA for the targeted optimization of image processing algorithms without requiring any human-labeled quality scores.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需人工标注的关系型图像质量评估方法，通过自监督合成失真引擎和对比学习，实现可解释的局部失真检测与相对质量评分。
AI.motivation: 传统IQA方法依赖MOS分数，收集成本高且缺乏可解释的局部失真反馈，难以指导特定图像处理算法的优化。
AI.method: 1) 自监督合成失真引擎生成训练数据；2) 反对称目标训练失真预测网络，输出空间感知的失真类型、强度与方向图；3) 对比学习在有序图像集上训练评分网络，预测关系型质量分数。
AI.result: 实现了无需人工标注的、细粒度的、可解释的图像质量评估，能够识别具体失真类型、强度和方向，并提供关系型质量分数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法从绝对质量预测转向关系型定向评估，为图像处理算法的针对性优化提供了更细粒度、可解释的IQA方案，完全摆脱了对人工标注的依赖。

title: Laplacian Frequency Interaction Network for Rural Thematic Road Extraction
summary: Rural thematic road network construction aims to extract topological road structures from movement trajectory images of agricultural machinery. However, this task faces challenges where downsampling methods commonly used in existing studies tend to blur the sparse high-frequency road structures, and the heavy noise from dense field operations often leads to fragmented or redundant topologies in the extracted networks. To address these challenges, we propose LFINet, a Laplacian Frequency Interaction Network. The network begins with a Laplacian Multi-scale Separator (LMS) to decouple the image into low-frequency semantic contexts and high-frequency structural details. These components are then processed by the Cross-Frequency Interaction Block (CFIB) through a dual-pathway architecture in which a High-Frequency Block (HFB) refines local structures while a Spatial Transformer (ST) captures global semantics. Subsequently, a Frequency Gated Modulation (FGM) mechanism integrates the features from pathways by leveraging semantic contexts to calibrate the structural details. Finally, a Progressive Reconstruction Decoder iteratively fuses multi-scale features to ensure topological consistency. Experiments conducted on a real-world agricultural trajectories dataset from Henan Province, China, show that LFINet establishes a new state-of-the-art. Specifically, it achieves an F1-score of 92.54% and an IoU of 86.12%, surpassing the second-ranked method by 0.64% and 1.1%, respectively. This confirms its capability to effectively construct topological road networks from noisy and sparse field data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LFINet网络，通过拉普拉斯频率交互机制从农业机械运动轨迹图像中提取乡村道路拓扑结构，在真实数据集上实现92.54%的F1分数和86.12%的IoU，达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理农业机械轨迹图像时，下采样会模糊稀疏的高频道路结构，而密集田间作业的强噪声导致提取的道路网络拓扑碎片化或冗余。
AI.method: 提出LFINet，包含拉普拉斯多尺度分离器(LMS)解耦图像为低/高频分量，双路径架构中高频块(HFB)细化局部结构、空间变换器(ST)捕获全局语义，频率门控调制(FGM)整合特征，渐进式重建解码器融合多尺度特征。
AI.result: 在中国河南省真实农业轨迹数据集上，F1分数92.54%，IoU 86.12%，分别超过第二名方法0.64%和1.1%。
AI.conclusion: LFINet能够有效从含噪稀疏的田间数据中构建拓扑一致的道路网络。

title: AlbumFill: Album-Guided Reasoning and Retrieval for Personalized Image Completion
summary: Personalized image completion aims to restore occluded regions in personal photos while preserving identity and appearance. Existing methods either rely on generic inpainting models that often fail to maintain identity consistency, or assume that suitable reference images are explicitly provided. In practice, suitable references are often not explicitly provided, requiring the system to search for identity-consistent images within personal photo collections. We present AlbumFill, a training-free framework that retrieves identity-consistent references from personal albums for personalized completion. Given an occluded image and a personal album, a vision-language model infers missing semantic cues to guide composed image retrieval, and the retrieved references are used by reference-based completion models. To facilitate this task, we introduce a dataset containing 54K human-centric samples with associated album images. Experiments across multiple baselines demonstrate the difficulty of personalized completion and highlight the importance of identity-consistent reference retrieval. Project Page: https://liagm.github.io/AlbumFill/

AI.tldr: AlbumFill是一种无需训练的图像补全框架，从个人相册中检索身份一致的照片作为参考，用于个性化图像补全，并提供了包含5.4万样本的数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化图像补全方法要么使用通用模型导致身份不一致，要么需要用户显式提供参考图像，而实际场景中用户不会主动提供合适的参考图。
AI.method: 提出AlbumFill框架：用视觉语言模型推断被遮挡区域的语义线索，指导组合式图像检索，从个人相册中检索身份一致的参考图像，再交由基于参考的图像补全模型完成修复。
AI.result: 构建了54K以人为中心的补全数据集，实验表明个性化图像补全任务具有挑战性，身份一致的参考检索至关重要。
AI.conclusion: AlbumFill无需训练即可从个人相册自动检索身份一致的参考图像，有效提升个性化图像补全的身份保持效果。
